@astryx.pagination.label.description: Aria label for the pagination navigation region.

@astryx.pagination.previous.description: Aria label for the previous-page button.

@astryx.pagination.next.description: Aria label for the next-page button.

@astryx.pagination.previousBy.description: Aria label for the previous button when it advances more than one page per click (the `step` prop > 1). `step` is the number of pages skipped.

@astryx.pagination.nextBy.description: Aria label for the next button when it advances more than one page per click (the `step` prop > 1). `step` is the number of pages skipped.

@astryx.pagination.first.description: Aria label for the first-page button (« double chevron) in the input pagination variant.

@astryx.pagination.last.description: Aria label for the last-page button (» double chevron) in the input pagination variant.

@astryx.pagination.goToPage.description: Aria label for an individual page-number button. `page` is 1-based.

@astryx.pagination.goToPageInput.description: Aria label for the editable page/row number box in the input pagination variant. No number — the box holds the value itself.

@astryx.pagination.pageLabel.description: Visible label before the editable box in the input pagination variant. Example: "Page [ 1 ] / 10".

@astryx.pagination.ofTotalPages.description: Visible total shown after the editable box in the input pagination variant. Example: the "/ 10" in "Page [ 1 ] / 10".

@astryx.pagination.pageIndicators.description: Aria label for the dots-variant page-indicator group.

@astryx.pagination.count.description: Visible range-of-total text on a pagination bar. Example: "1–20 of 347"; the en-dash is translator's choice.

@astryx.pagination.pageOfTotal.defaultMessage: 第 {current, number} 页，共 {total, number} 页
@astryx.pagination.pageOfTotal.description: Visible "Page X of Y" text on the compact pagination variant; also announced by screen readers. Keep short — sits in a compact toolbar.

@astryx.pagination.pageAnnounce.description: Screen-reader announcement when a page changes and total is unknown.

@astryx.powersearch.editor.field.description: Noun form-label above the field-picker dropdown in the PowerSearch filter-builder popover (which data column to filter on). Not an action.

@astryx.powersearch.editor.operator.description: Noun form-label above the operator dropdown in the PowerSearch filter-builder popover. Refers to a comparison verb ("is", "contains"), not a math or phone operator.

@astryx.powersearch.editor.addFilter.description: Button label inside a group in the PowerSearch filter-builder; adds another filter row (e.g. "Status = Active"). The leading "+ " is a plus-sign character.

@astryx.powersearch.editor.removeFilter.description: Screen-reader-only label on the "×" icon button next to a filter row in the PowerSearch editor; removes that row. Imperative verb.

@astryx.powersearch.editor.groupOperator.description: Screen-reader-only label for the AND/OR toggle that combines sibling filters inside a filter group. Sighted users see just "AND" or "OR".

@astryx.powersearch.editor.group.description: Fallback noun label shown on a nested filter-group chip when no AND/OR combining operator has been chosen. Use the noun ("a cluster"), not the verb "to group".

@astryx.powersearch.editor.delete.description: Button label inside the PowerSearch filter-editor popover; deletes the currently-edited filter row. Imperative verb form.

@astryx.powersearch.editor.cancel.description: Button label inside the PowerSearch filter-editor popover; closes the popover and discards pending edits. Imperative verb form.

@astryx.powersearch.editor.apply.description: Primary button label inside the PowerSearch filter-editor popover; confirms the edited filter. Imperative verb; consumers may override to "Save".

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.value.description: Noun form-label above a single free-text/number input in the PowerSearch value editor (e.g. the "acme" in `Name contains acme`). Not a verb or "worth".

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.values.description: Plural noun form-label above a multi-value chip input in the PowerSearch value editor. Should match its singular counterpart `Value` in your language.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.time.description: Noun form-label above a time-of-day (HH:MM) picker in the PowerSearch value editor. Clock time, not duration or era.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.date.description: Noun form-label above a calendar-date picker in the PowerSearch value editor. Calendar date, not romantic date or fruit.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.relative.description: Label for the relative-date selector (e.g. "Last 7 days") in the PowerSearch value editor.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.startDat.description: Noun form-label above the start-of-range date picker in the PowerSearch value editor. Pairs with `End date` — keep the two parallel in your language.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.endDate.description: Noun form-label above the end-of-range date picker in the PowerSearch value editor. Pairs with `Start date` — keep the two parallel.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.entities.description: "Entities" is jargon — plural noun form-label above an entity picker (people, teams, projects). Prefer a natural collective like "items" if your language has no equivalent.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.searchPl.description: Placeholder inside the search input in the PowerSearch entity/typeahead picker. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.enterVal.description: Placeholder inside a free-text single-value input in the PowerSearch value editor. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.addValue.description: Placeholder inside a multi-value chip input where the user types items and presses Enter to add each as a chip. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.enterNum.description: Placeholder inside a numeric input in the PowerSearch value editor. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.selectVa.description: Placeholder on a dropdown for choosing values from a fixed enum list in the PowerSearch value editor. Imperative verb (user selects, not types).

@astryx.powersearch.operator.contains.description: PowerSearch string operator, rendered inline as `<field> contains <value>` (e.g. `Name contains acme`). Lowercase verb form.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.notContains.description: PowerSearch negated string operator. Example: `Name does not contain test`. Lowercase; pairs with `contains`.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.startsWith.description: PowerSearch string prefix operator. Example: `Email starts with admin@`. Lowercase.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.notStartsWi.description: PowerSearch negated prefix operator. Example: `Email does not start with test`. Lowercase; pairs with `starts with`.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.endsWith.description: PowerSearch string suffix operator. Example: `Email ends with @meta.com`. Lowercase.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.notEndsWith.description: PowerSearch negated suffix operator. Example: `Email does not end with @gmail.com`. Lowercase; pairs with `ends with`.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.is.description: PowerSearch equality operator for strings/enums. Example: `Status is Active`. Separate from `operator.equals` (numbers) — translations may diverge.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.isNot.description: PowerSearch inequality operator for strings/enums. Example: `Status is not Draft`. Pairs with `is`; separate from `operator.notEquals`.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.equals.description: PowerSearch numeric equality operator. Example: `Age is 30`. Ships same English "is" as `operator.is` but is separate so numbers may diverge (e.g. "equals").

@astryx.powersearch.operator.notEquals.description: PowerSearch numeric inequality operator. Example: `Count is not 0`. Same divergence option as `operator.equals`.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.greaterThan.description: PowerSearch numeric operator, strictly greater than. Example: `Age is greater than 18`. Lowercase.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.lessThan.description: PowerSearch numeric operator, strictly less than. Example: `Priority is less than 5`. Lowercase.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.greaterThan.description: PowerSearch numeric operator, ≥. Example: `Age is greater than or equal to 21`. A shorter form (e.g. "≥") is fine if idiomatic.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.lessThanOrE.description: PowerSearch numeric operator, ≤. Example: `Priority is less than or equal to 3`. A shorter form is fine if idiomatic.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.before.description: PowerSearch date operator, strictly earlier. Example: `Created is before 2024-01-01`. Temporal, not spatial.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.after.description: PowerSearch date operator, strictly later. Example: `Updated is after 2024-06-01`. Temporal.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.between.description: PowerSearch date operator, inclusive range. Example: `Created is between 2024-01-01 and 2024-06-30`. The `and <end>` portion is composed separately.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.isTrue.description: PowerSearch boolean operator: matches truthy. Example: `Is admin is true`. Pairs with `is false`; field may be affirmative or a yes/no question.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.isFalse.description: PowerSearch boolean operator: matches falsy. Example: `Is admin is false`. Pairs with `is true`.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.isAnyOf.description: PowerSearch list operator: value is in the set. Example: `Status is any of [Active, Paused, Draft]`. The value list is composed separately; pairs with `is none of`.

@astryx.powersearch.operator.isNoneOf.description: PowerSearch negated list operator: value not in the set. Example: `Status is none of [Archived, Deleted]`. Pairs with `is any of`.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.itemsCou.description: Overflow summary on a compact filter chip when the list of selected items is too long. Example: `3 items` or `1 item`.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.entities.description: Overflow summary on a compact filter chip when the list of selected entities is too long. Example: `5 entities` or `1 entity`. Pair with `itemsCount` translation.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.dateRang.description: Fallback lowercase noun rendered inline in a filter chip when a date-range value can't be formatted (e.g. `Created is between date range`). Keep lowercase.

@astryx.powersearch.valueEditor.filtersC.description: Summary inside a filter chip when the value is a nested set of filters. Example: `3 filters` or `1 filter`.

@astryx.powersearch.resultCount.description: Live result-count text next to the PowerSearch input, announced to screen readers on change. Example: `12 results`, `1 result`; keep compact.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.filtersTitle.description: Heading and accessible name of the PowerSearch touch sheet that lists the active filters (experimental bottom-sheet presentation). Plural noun.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.addFilter.description: Button label in the PowerSearch touch flow: in the Filters sheet header it opens the field list; in the value step it confirms a new filter. Imperative verb; no leading plus sign.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.noFilters.description: Heading of the PowerSearch Filters sheet empty state when no filter is active (experimental bottom-sheet presentation). Neutral tone.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.noFiltersInDra.description: Heading of the PowerSearch Filters sheet empty state while the sheet's draft is empty but the field still has applied filters, which Done replaces. Must not say the filters are applied or removed yet. Neutral tone.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.noFiltersDescr.defaultMessage: 添加筛选条件以缩小结果范围，更快找到所需内容。
@astryx.powersearch.sheet.noFiltersDescr.description: Guidance line under the PowerSearch Filters sheet empty state, above its Add filter action. One short sentence.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.clearAll.description: Button label in the PowerSearch Filters sheet footer that asks to remove every editable filter. Imperative verb + determiner.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.clearAllTitle.description: Title and accessible name of the confirmation dialog that Clear all opens in the PowerSearch touch flow. A short question.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.clearAllDescri.defaultMessage: 这将从此搜索中移除所有可编辑的筛选条件。
@astryx.powersearch.sheet.clearAllDescri.description: Body text of the PowerSearch Clear all confirmation dialog. Read-only filters stay, so it names editable filters.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.clearAllConfir.description: Destructive action of the PowerSearch Clear all confirmation dialog: removes the editable filters. Imperative verb + plural noun.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.clearAllCancel.description: Safe action of the PowerSearch Clear all confirmation dialog: closes it and changes nothing. Imperative verb + plural noun.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.done.description: Primary button label in the PowerSearch Filters sheet footer that commits the sheet's filter draft and closes the sheet. Short; marks the end of the filtering task.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.discardTitle.description: Title of the confirmation dialog shown when someone tries to dismiss the PowerSearch filter sheet after changing its filter draft. A question.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.discardDescrip.defaultMessage: 你对筛选条件的更改尚未应用。
@astryx.powersearch.sheet.discardDescrip.description: Body of the dirty-dismiss confirmation inside the PowerSearch filter sheet. Done applies the draft; a dismissal would drop it.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.keepEditing.description: Label of the safe cancel action in the PowerSearch dirty-dismiss confirmation. It closes the confirmation and returns to the unchanged draft.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.discardConfirm.description: Label of the destructive action in the PowerSearch dirty-dismiss confirmation. It closes the sheet without applying its filter draft.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.search.description: Screen-reader-only label of the content-search box at the top of the PowerSearch Add filter sheet; its suggestions list inline below it. Noun or verb as reads best.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.searchResults.description: Screen-reader-only name of the inline suggestion list under the PowerSearch Add filter sheet's content search. Plural noun.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.searchFields.description: Screen-reader-only label of the field-list filter box in the PowerSearch Add filter sheet, shown once the config has eight or more fields. Imperative verb + plural noun.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.searchFieldsPl.description: Placeholder inside the field-list filter box in the PowerSearch Add filter sheet. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.ungroupedField.description: Heading of the PowerSearch Add filter sheet's list of fields that belong to no group, shown before the named groups. A short noun.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.noMatchingFiel.defaultMessage: 没有与搜索匹配的筛选条件
@astryx.powersearch.sheet.noMatchingFiel.description: Empty-state text in the PowerSearch Add filter sheet when the field-list filter matches no field. Neutral tone.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.tryDifferentSe.description: Guidance line under the PowerSearch Add filter sheet's empty search result ("No results found", "No filters match your search"). One short sentence.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.noResults.description: Empty-state text in the PowerSearch Add filter sheet when the content search has no suggestion for the typed query. Neutral tone (not error-y).

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.filterUnavaila.defaultMessage: 此筛选条件已不再可用
@astryx.powersearch.sheet.filterUnavaila.description: Message in the PowerSearch value step when a config update removed the field or operator being edited; Cancel remains as the way out, and the Filters row keeps its remove action.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.removeFilter.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the trailing remove button on a PowerSearch Filters sheet row; field is the filter's field label (for example "Remove Status filter").

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.relativeDaysAg.description: A relative-date choice row in the PowerSearch touch sheet, in the past (for example "3 days ago"). The popover editor lists the same choices.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.relativeDaysFr.description: A relative-date choice row in the PowerSearch touch sheet, in the future (for example "3 days from now"). The popover editor lists the same choices.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.relativeWeeksA.description: A relative-date choice row in the PowerSearch touch sheet, in the past (for example "3 weeks ago"). The popover editor lists the same choices.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.relativeWeeksF.description: A relative-date choice row in the PowerSearch touch sheet, in the future (for example "3 weeks from now"). The popover editor lists the same choices.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.relativeMonths.description: A relative-date choice row in the PowerSearch touch sheet, in the past (for example "3 months ago"). The popover editor lists the same choices.
A relative-date choice row in the PowerSearch touch sheet, in the future (for example "3 months from now"). The popover editor lists the same choices.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.fieldOperator.description: A field label joined with an operator label in the PowerSearch touch sheet: the value step's title, an operator radio's name, and the first part of a Filters row (for example "Status is"). Translators may reorder the two parts.

@astryx.powersearch.sheet.labelValue.description: A Filters row's "field operator" text joined with its value, as the removal announcement reads it (for example "Status is Open"). Translators may reorder the two parts.

@astryx.powersearch.token.fieldOperator.description: A filter token's field label joined with its operator label, before the token's value (for example "Status: is" in "Status: is Open"). Both parts are inserted text; translators may reorder them and change the punctuation.

@astryx.powersearch.token.labelValue.description: A filter token's "field: operator" text joined with its value, as the token's full text and the name of its controls read it (for example "Status: is Open"). Translators may reorder the two parts.

@astryx.alertDialog.cancel.description: Button label on the secondary/dismiss button of an AlertDialog (modal confirmation). Imperative verb; consumers usually override with task-specific text.

@astryx.appShell.mobileNavigation.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the mobile-only navigation region on small viewports. "Mobile" = phone/tablet (small screen), not "movable".

@astryx.appShell.skipToContent.description: Text of the skip link — the first focusable element on the page, visible only while keyboard-focused. Activating it jumps focus past the navigation to the main content area. Imperative verb; keep short.

@astryx.avatar.nameWithStatus.description: Screen-reader accessible name for an Avatar showing a status indicator; composes the person's name with the status label, e.g. "Jane Doe, Online". {name} = the avatar's name/alt text, {status} = the status dot's label. Adjust separator and order per locale.

@astryx.avatarGroup.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for a horizontal cluster of user avatar images. Plural noun; consumers usually override with "Team members", "Attendees", etc.

@astryx.avatarGroup.keyboardHint.defaultMessage: 使用箭头键在头像之间移动
@astryx.avatarGroup.keyboardHint.description: Screen-reader-only instruction attached (via aria-describedby) to a group of interactive avatars that share a single Tab stop. Tells keyboard users the Left/Right arrow keys move focus between the avatars. Only announced when the group has interactive (link/button) avatars.

@astryx.avatarGroup.overflow.description: Accessible name for the "+N" overflow indicator at the end of an AvatarGroup — announces how many additional avatars are not shown. Example: `5 more`. The visible "+N" text is unaffected; this is the aria-label only.

@astryx.banner.dismiss.description: "Dismiss" = close/hide this notification (not "reject a person"). Tooltip on the small X button on a Banner, and its aria label when the banner's title is not plain text.

@astryx.banner.dismissTitled.description: Aria label on the small X button on a Banner, naming which banner it closes so stacked banners are distinguishable. `{dismiss}` is the already-translated tooltip text from `banner.dismiss`; keep it verbatim in the message so visible and accessible labels match. `{title}` is the banner's own title text — example: `Dismiss Upload failed`. Reorder the placeholders freely.

@astryx.calendar.previousMonth.description: Screen-reader-only label on the left-arrow button in a Calendar's month header (navigates one month back). Pairs with `calendar.nextMonth`.

@astryx.calendar.nextMonth.description: Screen-reader-only label on the right-arrow button in a Calendar's month header (navigates one month forward). Pairs with `calendar.previousMonth`.

@astryx.calendar.daySelected.description: Accessible name for the Calendar day button that is the current single-mode selection. `{date}` is the localized full date, e.g. "Thursday, January 15, 2026". The trailing state word tells screen-reader users the focused day is selected.

@astryx.calendar.dayRangeStart.description: Accessible name for the Calendar day button that begins the selected date range (or the first pick of an in-progress range). `{date}` is the localized full date.

@astryx.calendar.dayRangeEnd.description: Accessible name for the Calendar day button that ends the selected date range. `{date}` is the localized full date. Pairs with `calendar.dayRangeStart`.

@astryx.calendar.dayRangeStartAndEnd.description: Accessible name for a Calendar day button that both begins and ends a completed one-day range. `{date}` is the localized full date.

@astryx.calendar.dayInRange.description: Accessible name for a Calendar day button strictly inside the selected date range (not an endpoint). `{date}` is the localized full date.

@astryx.calendar.rangeStartAnnounce.defaultMessage: 开始日期 {date}。请选择结束日期。
@astryx.calendar.rangeStartAnnounce.description: Screen-reader announcement after the first pick of a Calendar range selection. `{date}` is the localized full date. Prompts the user that a second pick completes the range.

@astryx.calendar.rangeCompleteAnnounce.description: Screen-reader announcement after the second pick completes a Calendar range selection. `{start}` and `{end}` are localized full dates in chronological order.

@astryx.calendar.rangeClearedAnnounce.defaultMessage: 已清除开始日期 {date}。请选择开始日期。
@astryx.calendar.rangeClearedAnnounce.description: Screen-reader announcement when the user clicks the in-progress range start again, which clears it instead of completing a zero-length range. `{date}` is the localized full date.

@astryx.carousel.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for a horizontally-scrolling row of items. If "carousel" is unfamiliar in your locale, prefer the standard term (e.g. "slider").

@astryx.carousel.scrollLeft.description: Screen-reader-only label on the left arrow button in a Carousel. Pairs with `carousel.scrollRight`; in RTL locales, coordinate the two so left/right match layout.

@astryx.carousel.scrollRight.description: Screen-reader-only label on the right arrow button in a Carousel. Pairs with `carousel.scrollLeft`; same RTL note.

@astryx.carousel.slideLabel.defaultMessage: 第 {current, number} 张幻灯片，共 {total, number} 张
@astryx.carousel.slideLabel.description: Screen-reader accessible name for one slide in a Carousel, giving its position. `current` is the 1-based slide number; `total` is the slide count.

@astryx.chart.label.description: Generic screen-reader name for a Chart with no primary series and no consumer-supplied title. Noun (a data visualization), not a verb.

@astryx.chart.labelWithSeries.defaultMessage: 按 {xKey} 显示 {series} 的图表
@astryx.chart.labelWithSeries.description: Generated screen-reader name for a Chart without a consumer-supplied title. `{series}` is a locale-formatted list of series labels; `{xKey}` is the consumer's horizontal data-field name.

@astryx.chart.dataTableCaption.description: Screen-reader-only caption for the small-data table that mirrors a Chart. `{label}` is the Chart's resolved accessible name.

@astryx.chartLegend.label.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the list of series labels and swatches rendered by ChartLegend.

@astryx.chat.status.sending.description: Chat send-status caption under an outgoing message while it is being transmitted. Part of the set sending → sent → delivered → read (or failed) — keep tense/aspect consistent.

@astryx.chat.status.sent.description: Chat send-status caption shown once the message reaches the server. Part of the set sending → **sent** → delivered → read (or failed) — keep tense consistent.

@astryx.chat.status.delivered.description: Chat send-status caption shown once the recipient's device received the message. Part of the set sending → sent → **delivered** → read (or failed).

@astryx.chat.status.read.description: Chat send-status caption shown once the recipient opened the message. English past-participle ("has been read", /rɛd/), not the present verb — part of the set sending → sent → delivered → **read**.

@astryx.chat.status.failed.description: Chat send-status caption shown when the send attempt errored. Part of the set — the terminal failure branch, orthogonal to the sent → delivered → read success track.

@astryx.chat.messageAriaLabel.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for a chat message row. `{status}` interpolates the localized status word (e.g. `Message sent`, `Message delivered`) — reorder if needed.

@astryx.chat.pastedText.expand.description: Button label on a chip in the chat composer representing a long pasted text block; clicking reveals full content. "Expand" here means reveal more, not grow physically.

@astryx.chat.pastedText.label.defaultMessage: {lines, plural, =1 {{chars, plural, other {{chars} 个字符}}} other {{lines} 行，{chars, plural, other {{chars} 个字符}}}}
@astryx.chat.pastedText.label.description: Count label on a pasted-text chip and its hover preview in the chat composer. {lines} is the number of text lines and {chars} is the character count. The single-line branch omits the line count. Translators may reorder the counts and localize the abbreviated units.

@astryx.checkboxList.item.checkbox.description: Localized hidden text used internally when a rich visible label names the checkbox through aria-labelledby. It does not become the computed name; callers must provide aria-label when rich content has no text.

@astryx.commandPalette.emptySearch.description: Fallback empty-state text inside a CommandPalette when the user's query has no matches. Very short (2 words); neutral tone.

@astryx.commandPalette.emptyBootstrap.description: Onboarding empty-state text shown inside a CommandPalette on first open, before the user has typed anything. Imperative sentence fragment.

@astryx.commandPalette.resultCount.description: Screen-reader-only announcement of how many commands match the CommandPalette query as the user types. Example: `12 results`, `1 result`; keep compact.

@astryx.commandPalette.noResultsFor.description: Not read by any component: CommandPalette announces its rendered empty-search message (`emptySearchText`) instead. Formerly the screen-reader-only announcement when a query matched nothing; `{query}` was the user's verbatim search text.

@astryx.commandPalette.loading.description: Screen-reader-only announcement that a CommandPalette search has started and results are being fetched. Present-progressive form; matches the visible spinner.

@astryx.dateRangeInput.presetDateRanges.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the sidebar of quick-pick preset ranges inside a DateRangeInput popover (e.g. "Last 7 days", "This month").

@astryx.dateTimeInput.timePlaceholder.description: Grey placeholder inside the empty time-of-day slot in a DateTimeInput. "Time" = clock time (HH:MM), not duration.

@astryx.dialog.close.description: "Close" = shut/dismiss the dialog, not "nearby" (English homograph). Aria label AND tooltip on the X at the top-right of a Dialog.

@astryx.dropdownMenu.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for a dropdown menu popover. Very generic; consumers usually override. Noun ("a menu"), not the imperative.

@astryx.dropdownMenu.back.description: Button label that returns from a nested action list to its parent inside a DropdownMenu bottom sheet. Imperative navigation action.

@astryx.dropdownMenu.backTo.description: Menu row that returns from a drilled-in sub-menu to the menu it came from. {parent} is that menu's name (e.g. "Back to Actions"). Imperative navigation action.

@astryx.lightbox.close.description: "Close" = shut/dismiss (not "nearby"). Screen-reader-only label on the X button that dismisses a Lightbox.

@astryx.lightbox.previous.description: Screen-reader-only label on the left-arrow button in a Lightbox (navigates to previous media item). Pairs with `lightbox.next`.

@astryx.lightbox.next.description: Screen-reader-only label on the right-arrow button in a Lightbox (navigates to next media item). Pairs with `lightbox.previous`.

@astryx.chatTypingIndicator.one.description: Politely announced status naming the single person currently typing in a chat. `name` is a display name supplied by the app. Present-progressive form; the trailing ellipsis is the single … character.

@astryx.chatTypingIndicator.many.description: Politely announced status when more than one person is typing in a chat. `names` is already joined for the locale by Intl.ListFormat, so translations must not add their own conjunction — place `{names}` where the joined list belongs.

@astryx.chatTypingIndicator.others.defaultMessage: 另外 {count, number} {count, plural, one {人} other {人}}
@astryx.chatTypingIndicator.others.description: Overflow element for the chat typing status when three or more people type: the first name is shown and the rest collapse into this phrase, which is then joined to the name by Intl.ListFormat. Renders as the last list item, e.g. "Ana and 2 others".

@astryx.list.reorderHandle.description: Accessible label on the handle at the end of a List row that drags the row to a new place or moves it with the arrow keys. `{label}` is the row's text (e.g. "Reorder Inbox").

@astryx.list.reorderHandleVerb.description: The handle's own accessible label at the end of a List row named through the row's label element: read first, then the row's label (e.g. "Reorder" then "Inbox"), so a label of any shape completes it. The verb alone, without the row's label.

@astryx.list.reorderHandleAt.defaultMessage: 调整第 {position, number} 项的顺序
@astryx.list.reorderHandleAt.description: Accessible label on a List row's reorder handle when the row has no text label to name it after. `{position}` is the row's 1-based place in the list (e.g. "Reorder item 3").

@astryx.list.reorderHint.defaultMessage: 拖动可移动此项目，或按 Space 或 Enter，然后使用方向键一次移动一个位置。完成后按 Escape。
@astryx.list.reorderHint.description: Description read after the label of every reorder handle in a List: how to move a row by dragging, or in reorder mode, which the handle's Space or Enter turns on and Escape ends.

@astryx.list.reorderPlace.defaultMessage: {label}，第 {position, number} 个位置，共 {total, number} 个位置，位于 {previous} 之后、{next} 之前
@astryx.list.reorderPlace.description: Screen-reader announcement after each move of a List row in reorder mode. `{label}` is the row's text, `{position}` its new 1-based place, `{total}` the number of rows, and `{previous}` and `{next}` the texts of the rows now before and after it (e.g. "Milk, position 3 of 5, after Eggs, before Bread").

@astryx.list.reorderPlaceTop.defaultMessage: {label}，第 {position, number} 个位置，共 {total, number} 个位置，位于最前，在 {next} 之前
@astryx.list.reorderPlaceTop.description: Screen-reader announcement after a List row in reorder mode moves to the first place. `{label}` is the row's text, `{position}` its 1-based place, `{total}` the number of rows, and `{next}` the text of the row now after it (e.g. "Milk, position 1 of 5, at the top, before Eggs").

@astryx.list.reorderPlaceEnd.defaultMessage: {label}，第 {position, number} 个位置，共 {total, number} 个位置，位于 {previous} 之后，排在最后
@astryx.list.reorderPlaceEnd.description: Screen-reader announcement after a List row in reorder mode moves to the last place. `{label}` is the row's text, `{position}` its 1-based place, `{total}` the number of rows, and `{previous}` the text of the row now before it (e.g. "Milk, position 5 of 5, after Bread, at the end").

@astryx.list.reorderRefused.description: Screen-reader announcement when an arrow key in reorder mode would move a List row past a row that keeps its place. `{label}` is that row's text (e.g. "Can't move past Pinned").

@astryx.list.reorderItemAt.description: What reorder announcements call a List row that shows no text, such as an icon-only row. `{position}` is its 1-based place (e.g. "after Item 2").

@astryx.list.reorderMoveUp.description: Accessible label of the up-arrow button in the hint a List row's reorder mode shows: it moves the row one place up, as the Up arrow key does.

@astryx.list.reorderMoveDown.description: Accessible label of the down-arrow button in the hint a List row's reorder mode shows: it moves the row one place down, as the Down arrow key does.

@astryx.list.reorderDone.description: Button in the hint a List row's reorder mode shows: it ends the mode and keeps the moves, as Escape does.

@astryx.list.reorderModeDone.defaultMessage: 已完成，{label} 位于第 {position, number} 个位置，共 {total, number} 个位置
@astryx.list.reorderModeDone.description: Screen-reader announcement when a List row's reorder mode ends (Escape, the handle again, or Done), keeping its moves. `{label}` is the row's text, `{position}` its 1-based place, `{total}` the number of rows (e.g. "Done, Milk at position 3 of 5").

@astryx.list.reorderPickedUp.defaultMessage: 已拾起，第 {position, number} 个位置，共 {total, number} 个位置。
@astryx.list.reorderPickedUp.description: Screen-reader announcement when a drag picks up a row of a List to reorder it. `{position}` is the row's 1-based place, `{total}` the number of rows.

@astryx.list.reorderDropped.defaultMessage: 已放下，第 {position, number} 个位置，共 {total, number} 个位置
@astryx.list.reorderDropped.description: Screen-reader announcement when a row being reordered in a List is dropped. `{position}` is its new 1-based place, `{total}` the number of rows.

@astryx.list.reorderCancelled.defaultMessage: 已取消重新排序，返回第 {position, number} 个位置，共 {total, number} 个位置
@astryx.list.reorderCancelled.description: Screen-reader announcement when a reorder in a List is cancelled and the row returns to where it was. `{position}` is that 1-based place, `{total}` the number of rows.

@astryx.listInput.emptyTitle.description: EmptyState title shown inside a lab ListInput when its collection has no records. `{itemName}` is the consumer's singular noun for one record (e.g. "guest"); the source appends a literal "s" to pluralize it, which only works for regular English plurals. If your language cannot pluralize an interpolated noun this way, rephrase around `{itemName}` instead (e.g. "No {itemName} added yet").

@astryx.listInput.emptyDescription.description: EmptyState supporting text shown inside a lab ListInput when its collection has no records. `{itemName}` is the consumer's singular noun for one record (e.g. "guest").

@astryx.listInput.addItem.description: Accessible label on the button that appends a new record to a lab ListInput. `{itemName}` is the consumer's singular noun for one record (e.g. "guest").

@astryx.listInput.removeItem.description: Accessible label and tooltip on the button that deletes one record from a lab ListInput. `{itemName}` is the consumer's singular noun for one record; `{position}` is its 1-based row number (e.g. "Remove guest 2").

@astryx.listInput.removeUnavailable.description: Tooltip shown on the Remove button when the ListInput is disabled or loading, explaining why the action cannot be performed.

@astryx.listInput.reorderItem.description: Accessible label on the drag-handle button that reorders one record in a lab ListInput. `{itemName}` is the consumer's singular noun for one record; `{position}` is its 1-based row number (e.g. "Reorder guest 2").

@astryx.listInput.itemName.description: The name of one record in a lab ListInput, which its reorder handle ("Reorder guest 2") and the reorder announcements use. `{itemName}` is the consumer's singular noun for one record; `{position}` is its 1-based row number (e.g. "guest 2").

@astryx.listInput.fieldLabelWithPosition.description: Accessible name for a field inside a lab ListInput row after the first row, disambiguating repeated column labels. `{header}` is the column's own label (e.g. "Name"); `{itemName}` is the consumer's singular noun for one record; `{position}`/`{total}` are the row's 1-based index and the total row count (e.g. "Name, guest 2 of 3").

@astryx.listInput.reorderInstructions.defaultMessage: 使用 Arrow Up 或 Arrow Down 将此项目移动一个位置。按 Space 或 Enter 将其拾起，以使用键盘继续重新排序。
@astryx.listInput.reorderInstructions.description: Visually-hidden instructions describing how to use a lab ListInput row's keyboard reorder handle, referenced via aria-describedby from every reorder button.

@astryx.listInput.announceAdded.description: Screen-reader-only live announcement after a new record is appended to a lab ListInput. `{itemName}` is the consumer's singular noun for one record; `{position}` is the new record's 1-based row number.

@astryx.listInput.announceRemoved.description: Screen-reader-only live announcement after a record is deleted from a lab ListInput. `{itemName}` is the consumer's singular noun for one record; `{position}` is the removed record's former 1-based row number.

@astryx.listInput.announceGrabbed.defaultMessage: 已拾起 {itemName} {position, number}。使用箭头键移动，按 Space 或 Enter 放下，按 Escape 取消。
@astryx.listInput.announceGrabbed.description: Screen-reader-only live announcement when a lab ListInput record's keyboard reorder handle enters extended "lift" mode. `{itemName}` is the consumer's singular noun for one record; `{position}` is its 1-based row number.

@astryx.listInput.announceMovedToPositio.defaultMessage: 已将 {itemName} 移至第 {position, number} 个位置，共 {total, number} 个位置。
@astryx.listInput.announceMovedToPositio.description: Screen-reader-only live announcement each time a lab ListInput record's reorder position changes (arrow-key step, keyboard lift-mode preview, or pointer drag). `{itemName}` is the consumer's singular noun for one record; `{position}`/`{total}` are the record's new 1-based position and the total row count.

@astryx.listInput.announceReorderCancell.description: Screen-reader-only live announcement when a lab ListInput reorder in progress is cancelled (Escape key, blur, or the collection becoming disabled/loading mid-drag).

@astryx.listInput.announceReturnedToPosi.defaultMessage: {itemName} 已返回第 {position, number} 个位置。
@astryx.listInput.announceReturnedToPosi.description: Screen-reader-only live announcement when a lab ListInput reorder is committed without the record's position actually changing. `{itemName}` is the consumer's singular noun for one record; `{position}` is its unchanged 1-based row number.

@astryx.listInput.announceDropped.defaultMessage: 已将 {itemName} 放在第 {position, number} 个位置，共 {total, number} 个位置。
@astryx.listInput.announceDropped.description: Screen-reader-only live announcement when a lab ListInput reorder is committed with the record's position actually changing. `{itemName}` is the consumer's singular noun for one record; `{position}`/`{total}` are its new 1-based position and the total row count.

@astryx.listInput.announceAlreadyAtBound.defaultMessage: 此 {itemName} 已位于{boundary, select, first {最前面} last {最后面} other {}}。
@astryx.listInput.announceAlreadyAtBound.description: Screen-reader-only live announcement when an arrow-key reorder attempt has no effect because the record is already at that end of the list. `{itemName}` is the consumer's singular noun for one record; `{boundary}` is always exactly "first" or "last".

@astryx.diffViewer.label.description: Accessible name of a lab DiffViewer's scrollable code area when the file has no path to name it.

@astryx.diffViewer.renamedPath.description: File path shown in a lab DiffViewer header when the file was renamed. `{oldPath}` and `{newPath}` are file paths and must stay untranslated; keep the arrow pointing from the old path to the new one.

@astryx.diffViewer.statusAdded.description: Badge in a lab DiffViewer file header marking a file that the change creates.

@astryx.diffViewer.statusDeleted.description: Badge in a lab DiffViewer file header marking a file that the change removes.

@astryx.diffViewer.statusRenamed.description: Badge in a lab DiffViewer file header marking a file that the change moves to a new path.

@astryx.diffViewer.addedCount.description: Compact count of added lines shown in a lab DiffViewer file header, e.g. "+12". Hidden from screen readers, which hear `@astryx.diffViewer.stats` instead.

@astryx.diffViewer.removedCount.description: Compact count of removed lines shown in a lab DiffViewer file header, e.g. "−3" (a minus sign). Hidden from screen readers, which hear `@astryx.diffViewer.stats` instead.

@astryx.diffViewer.stats.defaultMessage: {added, plural, other {新增 # 行}}，{removed, plural, other {删除 # 行}}
@astryx.diffViewer.stats.description: Screen-reader text for the line counts in a lab DiffViewer file header, e.g. "12 lines added, 3 lines removed".

@astryx.diffViewer.added.description: Screen-reader text marking one line of a lab DiffViewer as added by the change; sighted readers see a + sign and a tinted row.

@astryx.diffViewer.removed.description: Screen-reader text marking one line of a lab DiffViewer as removed by the change; sighted readers see a - sign and a tinted row.

@astryx.diffViewer.lineNumberButton.defaultMessage: {side, select, old {原始第 {line, number} 行} other {变更后第 {line, number} 行}}
@astryx.diffViewer.lineNumberButton.description: Accessible label of a clickable line number in a lab DiffViewer (callers use it, for example, to start a comment on that line). `side` is `old` for the file before the change and `new` for the file after it; `line` is the line number in that version.

@astryx.diffViewer.columnOldLine.description: Screen-reader-only header of a lab DiffViewer column holding line numbers in the file before the change. Pairs with `@astryx.diffViewer.lineNumberButton` ("Original line …").

@astryx.diffViewer.columnNewLine.description: Screen-reader-only header of a lab DiffViewer column holding line numbers in the file after the change. Pairs with `@astryx.diffViewer.lineNumberButton` ("Changed line …").

@astryx.diffViewer.columnChange.description: Screen-reader-only header of a lab DiffViewer column that marks each line as added or removed (noun: the kind of change).

@astryx.diffViewer.columnCode.description: Screen-reader-only header of the source-code column in a lab DiffViewer's single-column (unified) view.

@astryx.diffViewer.columnOldCode.description: Screen-reader-only header of the source-code column for the file before the change, in a lab DiffViewer's side-by-side (split) view.

@astryx.diffViewer.columnNewCode.description: Screen-reader-only header of the source-code column for the file after the change, in a lab DiffViewer's side-by-side (split) view.

@astryx.diffViewer.binary.description: Message in place of line changes in a lab DiffViewer when the file is binary and has no text diff.

@astryx.diffViewer.noChanges.description: Message in a lab DiffViewer when a file changed only its path or mode, so there are no line changes to show.

@astryx.diffViewer.largeChange.defaultMessage: 变更较大：{count, plural, other {# 行}}
@astryx.diffViewer.largeChange.description: Label of a folded block in a lab DiffViewer. The change was too large to compare line by line, so the block shows its old lines as removed and its new lines as added, folded until the reader opens it. `{count}` is the number of removed plus added lines in the block; some can be the same on both sides, because the block was not compared. Keep it short: it shares one row with the Show full diff button.

@astryx.diffViewer.showFullDiff.description: Button beside `@astryx.diffViewer.largeChange` in a lab DiffViewer that shows the folded lines of a large change. Pairs with `@astryx.diffViewer.hideFullDiff`.

@astryx.diffViewer.hideFullDiff.description: Button beside `@astryx.diffViewer.largeChange` in a lab DiffViewer that folds the lines of a large change again after `@astryx.diffViewer.showFullDiff` showed them.

@astryx.markdownHeadingLinks.copied.description: Accessible name on the Markdown heading copy button and text announced to a polite live region for ~1.5s after a successful copy. Sentence meaning "Link copied"; pairs with `markdownHeadingLinks.copy`.

@astryx.markdownHeadingLinks.copy.description: Accessible name on the Markdown heading copy button in its default state. `{heading}` is the heading's plain text, or its generated id when the text is empty; pairs with `markdownHeadingLinks.copied`.

@astryx.richTextEditor.tabEscapeHint.defaultMessage: 按 Escape 再按 Tab 可将焦点移出编辑器。
@astryx.richTextEditor.tabEscapeHint.description: Screen-reader-only hint attached to the RichTextEditor text area. Tab indents text inside the editor, so this tells keyboard users the two-key sequence that moves focus out of it.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.label.description: Accessible name of the formatting toolbar above a RichTextEditor.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.actions.description: Accessible name of the group that holds every formatting control in the RichTextEditor toolbar.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.undo.description: Label and tooltip of the toolbar button that undoes the last edit in a RichTextEditor.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.redo.description: Label and tooltip of the toolbar button that redoes the last undone edit in a RichTextEditor.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.historyDi.description: Screen-reader name of the divider between the undo/redo buttons and the block-format menu in the RichTextEditor toolbar.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.blockForm.description: Visually hidden label of the RichTextEditor toolbar menu that turns the current block into a paragraph, heading, list, or quote.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.formatDiv.description: Screen-reader name of the divider between the block-format menu and the bold/italic/etc. buttons in the RichTextEditor toolbar.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.paragraph.description: Block-format menu option: plain body text.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.bulletedL.description: Block-format menu option: a list whose items start with bullet markers.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.numberedL.description: Block-format menu option: a list whose items are numbered.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.blockQuot.description: Block-format menu option: an indented quotation block.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.bold.description: Label of the toolbar toggle that makes selected text bold.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.italic.description: Label of the toolbar toggle that makes selected text italic.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.underline.description: Label of the toolbar toggle that underlines selected text.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.strikethr.description: Label of the toolbar toggle that strikes a line through selected text.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.inlineCod.description: Label of the toolbar toggle that formats selected text as source code inside a sentence.

@astryx.richTextEditor.toolbar.link.description: Label of the toolbar toggle that opens the popover to add or edit a link on selected text.

@astryx.richTextEditor.link.insertTitle.description: Screen-reader name of the RichTextEditor link popover when it adds a new link.

@astryx.richTextEditor.link.editTitle.description: Screen-reader name of the RichTextEditor link popover when it changes or removes an existing link.

@astryx.richTextEditor.link.url.description: Visually hidden label of the web address field in the RichTextEditor link popover.

@astryx.richTextEditor.link.urlPlacehold.description: Placeholder of the web address field in the RichTextEditor link popover: an example address, shown while the field is empty. An address without a scheme is accepted and becomes an https link, so keep it a bare domain.

@astryx.richTextEditor.link.invalidUrl.defaultMessage: 请输入有效的 http、https、mailto 或 tel URL。
@astryx.richTextEditor.link.invalidUrl.description: Error under the link popover address field when the entered address is not allowed. Keep the scheme names http, https, mailto, and tel untranslated.

@astryx.richTextEditor.link.remove.description: Label and tooltip of the icon button in the RichTextEditor link popover that removes the link from the selected text and keeps the text.

@astryx.richTextEditor.link.cancel.description: Label and tooltip of the icon button that closes the RichTextEditor link popover without changing anything.

@astryx.richTextEditor.link.add.description: Label and tooltip of the icon button that applies the address in the RichTextEditor link popover when adding a new link.

@astryx.richTextEditor.link.update.description: Label and tooltip of the icon button that applies the address in the RichTextEditor link popover when changing an existing link address.

@astryx.markdown.taskList.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for a GitHub-flavored Markdown task list (rendered from `- [ ] item` / `- [x] done` syntax).

@astryx.markdown.table.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for a table rendered inside a Markdown block. Noun ("a table"), not the verb. Separate from `@astryx.table.label` — translations may diverge.

@astryx.mobileNav.closeNavigation.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X/close button that dismisses the MobileNav overlay. Pairs with `mobileNav.toggle.open`.

@astryx.multiSelector.selectAll.description: Label on the checkbox/toggle at the top of a MultiSelector dropdown that selects every option. "All" is a determiner here (as in "all the options"), not the pronoun.

@astryx.multiSelector.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside the search input at the top of a MultiSelector's dropdown panel. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@astryx.multiSelector.searchOptions.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for that same search input inside a MultiSelector.

@astryx.multiSelector.empty.description: Shown in a MultiSelector's dropdown panel when it was given no options at all, and announced in a polite live region on open. Very short (2 words); neutral tone, not error-y.

@astryx.multiSelector.selectAllPartially.description: Accessible name for the MultiSelector select-all option while only some options are selected. `{label}` is the visible select-all label (e.g. "Select all"). ARIA forbids aria-selected="mixed" on options, so the indeterminate state is conveyed through the name instead. "Partially" = some but not all.

@astryx.popover.close.description: "Close" = shut/dismiss, not "nearby". Screen-reader-only label on the close button inside a Popover.

@astryx.selector.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside the search input at the top of a Selector's dropdown panel (for filtering options). Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@astryx.selector.searchOptions.description: "Options" = the list of choices in the dropdown. Screen-reader-only accessible name for the search input inside a Selector.

@astryx.selector.empty.description: Shown in a Selector's dropdown panel when it was given no options at all, and announced in a polite live region on open. Very short (2 words); neutral tone, not error-y.

@astryx.sideNav.label.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the primary vertical sidebar nav (usually on the left).

@astryx.sideNav.resizeSidebar.description: Screen-reader-only label on the vertical drag handle at the right edge of the SideNav that lets the user resize the sidebar's width.

@astryx.sideNav.heading.openMenu.description: Screen-reader-only label on the `⋯` overflow-menu button embedded in a SideNav section heading. Same string as `topNav.heading.openMenu` — translations may share.

@astryx.slider.minimumThumb.description: Accessible name of the lower thumb of a range Slider (two thumbs), announced together with the Slider's own label, for example "Price range, Minimum value, 20". Never shown on screen.

@astryx.slider.maximumThumb.description: Accessible name of the upper thumb of a range Slider (two thumbs), announced together with the Slider's own label, for example "Price range, Maximum value, 80". Never shown on screen.

@astryx.tabBar.badgedItem.description: Screen-reader name of a bottom tab bar item that shows a badge ("Library, 3"). {label} is the tab's visible name; {badge} is the badge's count or its own label ("3 unread"). Translators may reorder the two or change the separator.

@astryx.tabBar.more.description: Label of the bottom tab bar's More tab, shown under its icon when an app has more than five tabs, and the screen-reader name of the list it opens (the remaining tabs). As iOS's "More" tab: a short word, not "Show more".

@astryx.tabList.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for a horizontal tab bar. Plural noun; "Tabs" here = UI tab panels, not browser tabs or the Tab key.

@astryx.table.label.description: Fallback screen-reader-only accessible name for a data-table region when the consumer provides none. Noun ("a table"), not the verb "to table".

@astryx.table.loadMore.description: Button that requests another batch of table rows. Verb phrase; shown while additional rows are available.

@astryx.table.noData.description: Fallback empty-state text in the table body when there are zero rows. Neutral tone (not error-y); consumers commonly override with something specific like "No results".

@astryx.table.columnResize.resizeColumn.description: Accessible name for a Table column-resize handle (a vertical separator between header cells). `label` is the column header's visible text, or the column key when the header has no text.

@astryx.table.columnResize.widthValue.description: Value a screen reader announces for a Table column-resize handle when the column has no maximum width. `width` is the column's current value as a whole number of CSS pixels, for example "133 pixels".

@astryx.table.filter.allPlaceholder.description: Placeholder on a per-column filter dropdown when nothing is selected, meaning "no filter — all rows match". Determiner form (as in "all values"), not the pronoun.

@astryx.table.filter.reset.description: Button label inside a table's filter panel/popover; clears pending filter values back to defaults. Imperative verb.

@astryx.table.filter.apply.description: Primary button label inside a table's filter panel/popover; commits pending filter values. Imperative verb; pairs with `Reset`.

@astryx.table.rowStatus.columnHeader.description: Screen-reader-only column header for the narrow status-indicator gutter a Table gains from useTableRowStatus. Sighted users see a blank gutter; assistive tech announces this as the column name.

@astryx.table.selection.bulkActionsLabel.description: Accessible name for the contextual Toolbar shown while Table rows are selected.

@astryx.table.selection.clearAll.description: Visible button label that clears the complete controlled Table row selection, including keys outside the current view.

@astryx.table.selection.selectedCount.description: Visible status in TableSelectionToolbar showing the number of selected rows.

@astryx.table.selection.selectAllRows.description: Aria label for the "select all rows" checkbox in a Table header.

@astryx.table.selection.selectRow.description: Aria label for the "select row" checkbox on a Table row.

@astryx.table.selection.selectRowNamed.description: Aria label for a Table row's selection checkbox when a per-row label is available (via getRowLabel). `label` is the row's human-readable identity, e.g. "Alice".

@astryx.table.sort.ascending.description: Screen-reader-only label on a column header button that will sort the column ascending. Part of a set with `sort.descending` and `sort.clear` — keep parallel.

@astryx.table.sort.descending.description: Screen-reader-only label on a column header button that will sort the column descending. Part of a set with `sort.ascending` and `sort.clear`.

@astryx.table.sort.clear.description: Screen-reader-only label on a column header button that will remove the current sort. "Clear" here means remove, not transparent. Part of the sort set.

@astryx.table.sort.priority.defaultMessage: 排序优先级：第 {rank, number} 个，共 {total, number} 个
@astryx.table.sort.priority.description: Screen-reader description of a sortable Table column header button while several columns are sorted: this column's place in the sort order. The button's name is the column header text and its direction is announced from aria-sort.

@astryx.toast.dismiss.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X button of a Toast (transient notification popup). Distinct from `banner.dismiss` (persistent banner).

@astryx.toast.viewport.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the invisible landmark region hosting the stack of Toast popups (usually pinned to a screen corner).

@astryx.tokenizer.clearAll.description: Label on the "×" button that removes every token/chip from a Tokenizer input. Imperative verb + determiner "all"; short.

@astryx.topNav.heading.openMenu.description: Screen-reader-only label on the `⋯` overflow button in a TopNav section heading. Kept separate from `sideNav.heading.openMenu` so translations may diverge.

@astryx.topNav.landmarkLabel.description: Default accessible name (aria-label) for the <nav> landmark rendered by TopNav when no label is provided.

@astryx.treeList.toggleChildren.description: "Children" = child nodes in the tree, not human children. Screen-reader-only label on the chevron next to a TreeList item that has children — toggles the sub-list.

@astryx.typeahead.emptySearchResults.description: Fallback empty-state message inside a Typeahead's suggestion popover when the current query has no matches. Neutral tone (not error-y).

@astryx.typeahead.loading.description: Screen-reader-only name for a spinner shown inside a Typeahead dropdown while suggestions are being fetched. Present-progressive form.

@astryx.typeahead.searchResults.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the list of suggestions inside a Typeahead dropdown.

@astryx.typeahead.selectionCleared.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after Backspace or Delete on a Typeahead's selected token clears its value. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{label}` is the cleared value's visible text.

@astryx.typeahead.clearSelection.description: "Selection" = the chosen value (not highlighted text). Screen-reader-only label on the X that clears the currently-selected value from a Typeahead.

@astryx.breadcrumbs.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for the breadcrumb trail (e.g. `Home > Section > Page`). Singular in English per ARIA convention; plural is fine if natural in your locale.

@astryx.chat.composer.placeholder.description: Grey placeholder text inside the empty chat composer textarea. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@astryx.chat.composerDrawer.label.description: Fallback aria label for the ChatComposerDrawer — a horizontal list of attachment/tool chips. Consumers usually override with "Attachments", "Tools", etc.

@astryx.chat.composerInput.label.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the chat composer textarea. Reorder freely if your language uses one word for "message field".

@astryx.chat.speechRecognition.noSpeechD.description: Full-sentence error shown inline in the chat composer after voice input captured silence. Soft-error tone (not alarming); keep terminal period.

@astryx.commandPalette.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for a keyboard-driven command menu (usually opened with Cmd/Ctrl-K). If unfamiliar, prefer a natural equivalent like "quick actions".

@astryx.commandPalette.input.placeholder.description: Grey placeholder inside the CommandPalette's search input. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@astryx.commandPalette.input.label.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the CommandPalette query input. Distinguish it from the visible placeholder; verb followed by the app actions being searched.

@astryx.commandPalette.list.label.description: "Command" = an app action a user can invoke (metaphor from CLI), not a Unix command. Screen-reader-only name for the matching-commands list.

@astryx.contextMenu.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for the right-click / long-press popup menu. "Context" = context-specific to the activated element, not linguistic context.

@astryx.dateInput.placeholder.description: Grey placeholder inside an empty DateInput field. "Date" = calendar date, not romantic or fruit. Imperative verb.

@astryx.dateInput.dialogLabel.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the popover dialog opened from a DateInput's calendar toggle. Imperative verb + noun.

@astryx.dateInput.closeCalendar.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X inside the DateInput calendar popover (dismisses the popover). Distinct from `dateInput.toggleCalendarClose`, which labels the outer toggle.

@astryx.dateInput.openCalendar.description: Aria label for the DateInput / DateRangeInput / DateTimeInput calendar toggle button when the popover is closed.

@astryx.dateInput.toggleCalendarClose.description: Aria label for the DateInput / DateRangeInput / DateTimeInput calendar toggle button when the popover is open. Distinct from closeCalendar (which labels the X inside the popover) so translators can differentiate the toggle vs the close-X UI.

@astryx.dateInput.clear.description: Aria label for the clear-value button in DateInput / DateRangeInput / DateTimeInput. `{label}` is the field's own label so screen readers announce e.g. 'Clear Start date'.

@astryx.dateInput.invalidDate.description: Screen-reader-only live-region alert in DateInput / DateTimeInput when the typed date cannot be parsed. The field silently reverts on blur, so this is the only rejection feedback a screen-reader user gets.

@astryx.dateInput.nonexistentDate.defaultMessage: {named, select, yes {请输入真实日期（{calendar}）} other {请输入真实日期}}
@astryx.dateInput.nonexistentDate.description: Error in DateInput / DateTimeInput, shown below the field and announced, when the typed date is readable but the calendar does not have it, such as February 30 or 30 Esfand in a common Persian year. Ask for a date that exists, in plain words. `named` is `yes` when the field's calendar differs from the app's calendar, and then {calendar} is the calendar's localized name from the platform, such as "Persian Calendar"; keep it in parentheses, because the name is a standalone form that may not fit inside a sentence.

@astryx.dateInput.outOfRangeDate.defaultMessage: {bounds, select, both {请输入 {min} 至 {max} 之间的日期} min {请输入 {min} 或之后的日期} max {请输入 {max} 或之前的日期} other {请输入可用日期}}
@astryx.dateInput.outOfRangeDate.description: Error in DateInput / DateTimeInput, shown below the field and announced, when the typed date is outside the allowed range. {min} and {max} are the bounds, written as dates in the field's calendar. `bounds` is `both`, `min`, or `max` for a date outside those bounds, and `other` for a date that a custom rule rejects.

@astryx.dateInput.formatHint.description: Placeholder hint in a DateInput / DateTimeInput date field that uses a calendar other than the Gregorian calendar, shown when the field is focused and empty. {example} is today's date, or the nearest date the field accepts, written in that calendar's numeric pattern, such as ۱۴۰۵/۸/۱۱.

@astryx.dateInput.calendarDescription.description: Screen-reader-only description of a DateInput / DateTimeInput date field whose calendar differs from the app's calendar, such as a Persian field in a Gregorian app or a Gregorian field in a Persian app. {calendar} is the calendar's localized name from the platform, such as "Persian Calendar" or "Gregorian Calendar".

@astryx.dateInput.resetPicking.description: Ghost button in the mobile date picker's header, at the trailing corner beside the month arrows. Removes the chosen date AND returns the calendar to the current month — it undoes the picking done so far and puts the picker back to how it opens, so prefer a word covering both, not one that only means emptying a field. Not cancel: the picker stays open afterwards and nothing is dismissed. Keep it short; it shares one line with the month title and two arrows.

@astryx.dateInput.savePicking.description: Full-width primary button that closes the mobile date picker, on the calendar. The date is already committed by the tap that chose it, so this only dismisses — but it is worded as saving because that is how the action reads to someone finishing a form. Use the word your platform uses for accepting and closing a sheet.

@astryx.dateInput.doneChoosingMonth.description: Full-width button under the month and year wheels in the mobile date picker. It does NOT close the picker — it returns to the calendar, having set the month. Word it as finishing this step, not as finishing the whole task; the calendar's own button is the one that closes.

@astryx.dateInput.chooseMonthYear.description: Accessible name for the mobile date picker's header button, which swaps the calendar for month and year wheels. {monthYear} is the currently shown month and year, already localized (e.g. "March 2026"). The whole label is one string so the separator and word order can change per locale.

@astryx.dateInput.monthWheel.description: Accessible name for the scrollable month column in the mobile date picker. Single word; a calendar month, not a duration.

@astryx.dateInput.yearWheel.description: Accessible name for the scrollable year column in the mobile date picker. Single word; a calendar year, not a duration.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.timeHint12h.description: Placeholder hint shown in the DateTimeInput time field when focused and empty with 12-hour format. Gives an example of expected input format.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.timeHint24h.description: Placeholder hint shown in the DateTimeInput time field when focused and empty with 24-hour format. Gives an example of expected input format.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.timeSuffix.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the time-of-day slot in a DateTimeInput. Example: `Start date time`; reorder freely (e.g. "time of {label}").

@astryx.dateTimeInput.timeOptionsLabel.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the list of preset times that drops down from a DateTimeInput's time slot. `{label}` is the accessible name of the time field itself, already ending in the word for time — example: `Meeting time options`. Plural: the list holds every selectable time.

@astryx.dateRangeInput.placeholder.description: Grey placeholder inside an empty DateRangeInput field. Represents picking a start–end date pair. Imperative verb.

@astryx.dateRangeInput.dialogLabel.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the popover dialog opened from a DateRangeInput. Imperative verb + noun phrase.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.placeholder.description: Grey placeholder inside an empty DateTimeInput field. Note: the English says only "date" though the field is date+time — do not add "and time" unless natural.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.dialogLabel.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the DateTimeInput picker dialog. On desktop this labels the date calendar popover inside the date+time field; on touch devices it labels the full Date/Time bottom sheet.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.pickerMode.description: Screen-reader-only label for the segmented Date/Time switch at the top of the mobile DateTimeInput bottom sheet.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.dateTab.description: Visible label for the Date segment in the mobile DateTimeInput bottom sheet.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.timeTab.description: Visible label for the Time segment in the mobile DateTimeInput bottom sheet.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.openTimePicker.description: Aria label for the clock button in the mobile DateTimeInput closed time segment. `{label}` is the accessible name of the time input, for example `Meeting time`.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.saveDatePicking.description: Primary button at the bottom of the Date panel in the mobile DateTimeInput bottom sheet. It does not close the sheet; it accepts the date step and moves to the Time panel. Use sentence case in English and title case only when appropriate for the locale.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.hourWheel.description: Accessible name for the hour wheel in the mobile DateTimeInput bottom sheet.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.minuteWheel.description: Accessible name for the minute wheel in the mobile DateTimeInput bottom sheet.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.secondWheel.description: Accessible name for the optional seconds wheel in the mobile DateTimeInput bottom sheet.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.meridiemWheel.description: Accessible name for the AM/PM wheel in the mobile DateTimeInput bottom sheet when using 12-hour time.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.meridiemAM.description: Label for the morning half of the AM/PM wheel in the mobile DateTimeInput bottom sheet. Use the locale's concise ante-meridiem marker.

@astryx.dateTimeInput.meridiemPM.description: Label for the afternoon/evening half of the AM/PM wheel in the mobile DateTimeInput bottom sheet. Use the locale's concise post-meridiem marker.

@astryx.link.newTab.description: Visually-hidden (screen-reader-only) suffix appended to a Link's accessible name when it opens in a new tab. Example: `Documentation (opens in new tab)`.

@astryx.mobileNav.toggle.open.description: Screen-reader-only label on the hamburger button that opens the MobileNav overlay (rendered when the overlay is closed). Pairs with `mobileNav.closeNavigation`.

@astryx.moreMenu.label.description: Screen-reader-only name for the small `⋯` (three-dots) overflow button that opens a menu of additional actions. Very short — sits on a tiny icon button.

@astryx.multiSelector.selectPlaceholder.description: Placeholder on an empty MultiSelector trigger button. Same English as `selector.placeholder` but a separate key — plural phrasing like "Choose items…" is fine.

@astryx.outline.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for a page's outline / table-of-contents sidebar (list of in-page headings). Rendered as `aria-label` on a `<nav>` landmark.

@astryx.powersearch.label.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the PowerSearch input (a filter-builder). The visible placeholder is separate; noun form often reads better than the verb.

@astryx.powersearch.placeholder.description: Grey placeholder text inside the empty PowerSearch input. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@astryx.powersearch.allFiltersRemoved.description: Screen-reader announcement after a PowerSearch field's Clear all removes every filter. Distinct from @astryx.tokenizer.allRemoved: PowerSearch words its items as filters.

@astryx.powersearch.editableFiltersRemov.defaultMessage: 已移除可编辑的筛选条件
@astryx.powersearch.editableFiltersRemov.description: Screen-reader announcement after a PowerSearch field's Clear all removes the filters the user can edit and keeps its read-only filters. Used instead of @astryx.powersearch.allFiltersRemoved while a read-only filter remains.

@astryx.resizable.collapsed.description: aria-valuetext for the Resizable drag handle (role=separator) while its panel is collapsed to zero size. Replaces the numeric value announcement, since the numeric value is clamped to the minimum while collapsed. Adjective describing the panel state, not a verb/command.

@astryx.resizable.handle.label.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the small draggable divider between two Resizable panels (users drag it to change the split ratio).

@astryx.selector.placeholder.description: Placeholder text on an empty Selector trigger button (a dropdown). Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character. Very short — appears on the button face.

@astryx.sideNav.heading.dialogLabel.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the dropdown dialog opened from a SideNavHeading's overflow menu.

@astryx.table.pagination.label.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for a table's pagination `<nav>` (rendered below and/or above the table per the plugin's position config). Kept separate from `@astryx.pagination.label` so translations may diverge. When position='both', this string is interpolated as the {label} value into `@astryx.table.pagination.labelAbove`/`labelBelow` — keep it compatible with those suffix templates.

@astryx.table.pagination.labelAbove.description: Accessible name for the pagination `<nav>` rendered above the table when position='both' renders two navs. `label` is the resolved base label (default "Table pagination" or consumer-supplied); the suffix keeps the two same-type landmarks distinguishable.

@astryx.table.pagination.labelBelow.description: Accessible name for the pagination `<nav>` rendered below the table when position='both' renders two navs. `label` is the resolved base label (default "Table pagination" or consumer-supplied); the suffix keeps the two same-type landmarks distinguishable.

@astryx.timeInput.placeholder.description: "Time" = clock time (HH:MM), not duration or era. Grey placeholder inside an empty TimeInput field; imperative verb.

@astryx.timeInput.invalidTime.description: Screen-reader-only live-region alert in TimeInput / DateTimeInput when the typed time cannot be parsed. "Time" = clock time (HH:MM). The field silently reverts on blur, so this is the only rejection feedback a screen-reader user gets.

@astryx.timeInput.openPicker.description: Aria label for the clock button that opens TimeInput's browser/OS time picker. `{label}` is the field label, for example `Start time`.

@astryx.topNav.heading.dialogLabel.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for the dropdown dialog opened from a TopNavHeading's overflow menu. Kept separate from the SideNav sibling.

@astryx.typeahead.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside an empty Typeahead input (a search field that suggests results as the user types). Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.

@astryx.banner.collapse.description: "Collapse" = fold up, not crumble. Aria label AND tooltip on the Banner expand/collapse toggle when currently expanded. Pairs with `banner.expand`.

@astryx.banner.expand.description: "Expand" = reveal more, not grow physically. Aria label AND tooltip on the same toggle when currently collapsed. Pairs with `banner.collapse`.

@astryx.button.loading.description: Screen-reader-only live-region announcement while a Button is in its loading state (spinner shown, action in flight). Progressive sense ("work in progress"), not a noun. Kept separate from `typeahead.loading` — translations may diverge.

@astryx.spinner.loading.description: Screen-reader-only default name for a standalone Spinner's role="status" element, used when the consumer supplies neither `aria-label` nor a visible string label. Present-progressive form. Kept separate from `button.loading` and `typeahead.loading` — translations may diverge.

@astryx.scrollRegion.label.description: Accessible name of a scrolling content region (LayoutContent, LayoutPanel or StackItem) when the caller gives none. A screen reader announces it with the region's group role while the region scrolls.

@astryx.chatComposerDrawer.expand.description: Screen-reader-only label on the ChatComposerDrawer toggle when the drawer is collapsed. `{label}` is the drawer's visible name — example: `Expand Attachments`. Pairs with `collapse`.

@astryx.chatComposerDrawer.collapse.description: Screen-reader-only label on the ChatComposerDrawer toggle when the drawer is expanded. Example: `Collapse Attachments`. Pairs with `expand`.

@astryx.chatDictationButton.startDictati.description: Accessible label for the microphone button when idle (not listening).

@astryx.chatDictationButton.stopDictatio.description: Accessible label for the microphone button when actively listening.

@astryx.chatLayout.newMessages.description: Text on a floating pill at the bottom of a chat viewport when unseen messages arrive below the fold; clicking scrolls to bottom. Keep short — narrow pill.

@astryx.chatVirtualizer.label.description: Accessible name of a lab ChatVirtualizer's own scroll container, which keyboard users can focus and scroll, when the caller gives no label.

@astryx.chatLayoutScrollButton.scrollToB.description: Visible tooltip AND screen-reader label for a small down-arrow button that scrolls the chat viewport to its latest message.

@astryx.chatMessage.messageFrom.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for a chat message when the sender name isn't visible. Example: `Message from Sarah`, `Message from Bot` — reorder freely.

@astryx.chatSendButton.stop.description: Button label that replaces `Send` on the chat send button while an AI response is streaming; clicking aborts generation. Short — appears on a small button.

@astryx.chatSendButton.send.description: Primary button label on the chat submit button (paperplane icon). Imperative verb; pairs with `Stop`. Very short.

@astryx.chatToolCalls.error.description: Screen-reader text for a tool call that failed. {message} is the error detail.

@astryx.chatToolCalls.status.pending.description: Screen-reader-only status label for a tool call that is waiting to begin.

@astryx.chatToolCalls.status.running.description: Screen-reader-only status label for a tool call that is currently running.

@astryx.chatToolCalls.status.complete.description: Screen-reader-only status label for a tool call that completed successfully.

@astryx.chatToolCalls.status.error.description: Screen-reader-only status label for a failed tool call when no error detail is supplied.

@astryx.chatToolCalls.groupLabel.description: Summary label shown in the group header when multiple tool calls are expanded. {count} is the number of calls.

@astryx.chatTriggerMenu.searching.description: Shown, and announced politely to screen readers, while a chat composer's @-mention or slash-command menu waits for async search results. Present participle; trailing `…` is one character.

@astryx.chatTriggerMenu.suggestions.description: Screen-reader-only fallback label for the popover listbox opened by a trigger character (`@`, `/`) in the chat composer when the trigger provides no specific label.

@astryx.citation.label.description: Screen-reader-only accessible name for a Citation chip (a small numbered link to a source). Example: `Citation 1: OpenAI research paper`. Reorder freely.

@astryx.codeBlock.copied.description: Screen-reader-only label on the CodeBlock copy button for ~2s after a successful copy. Past-participle ("has been copied"); pairs with `codeBlock.copyCode`.

@astryx.codeBlock.copyCode.description: "Code" = source code. Aria label AND tooltip on the CodeBlock copy button in its default state. Pairs with `codeBlock.copied` (post-click state).

@astryx.codeBlock.copyFailed.description: Aria label, tooltip and screen-reader announcement on the CodeBlock copy button for ~2s after the clipboard write fails. Pairs with `codeBlock.copyCode` and `codeBlock.copied`.
