@astryx.codeBlock.code.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for a code-snippet scroll container when the code's language is unknown. "Code" = source code, not secret code or code of conduct.

@astryx.field.optional.description: Visible indicator shown next to a form field's label when the field is optional (isOptional). Mutually exclusive with the required indicator. Very short — appears inline after the label text.

@astryx.field.labelTooltip.description: Screen-reader name of the small info button after a form field's label; the button shows help about the field. {label} is the field's visible label. Example: `About Auto-save`.

@astryx.field.required.description: Visible indicator shown next to a form field's label when the field must be filled in (isRequired). Mutually exclusive with the optional indicator. Very short — appears inline after the label text.

@astryx.fileInput.clearLabel.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X that removes the selected file from a FileInput. Example: `Clear Attachment`, `Clear Résumé`.

@astryx.fileInput.dropHint.description: Text shown in the dropzone area when a user is dragging files over the FileInput.

@astryx.fileInput.errorInvalidType.description: Validation error shown when a selected file does not match the accepted types.

@astryx.fileInput.errorMaxFiles.description: Validation error shown when the number of selected files exceeds the maximum.

@astryx.fileInput.errorMaxSize.description: Validation error shown when a selected file exceeds the maximum size. {maxSize} is a formatted size string like "2.0 MB".

@astryx.fileInput.fileSelected.description: Live-region announcement when a single file is successfully selected.

@astryx.fileInput.fileSize.bytes.description: File-size limit below 1024 bytes in FileInput validation feedback. {size} is a number of bytes. Localize the unit abbreviation; do not add digit grouping.

@astryx.fileInput.fileSize.kilobytes.description: File-size limit from 1024 bytes up to one megabyte in FileInput validation feedback. {size} is bytes divided by 1024, displayed to one decimal place without digit grouping. Localize the unit abbreviation.

@astryx.fileInput.fileSize.megabytes.description: File-size limit of at least one megabyte in FileInput validation feedback. {size} is bytes divided by 1048576, displayed to one decimal place without digit grouping. Localize the unit abbreviation.

@astryx.fileInput.filesSelected.description: Live-region announcement when multiple files are successfully selected.

@astryx.fileInput.placeholder.description: Default placeholder text shown when no file is selected in a single-file FileInput.

@astryx.fileInput.placeholderMultiple.description: Default placeholder text shown when no files are selected in a multi-file FileInput.

@astryx.fileInput.required.description: Screen-reader-only description on the FileInput trigger indicating the field must be filled in. Mirrors the visible `Required` indicator next to the field label; conveyed via description because aria-required is not supported on role="button".

@astryx.fileInput.triggerWithFiles.description: Accessible name for a FileInput trigger that has files attached, composing the field label with the selected filenames. Example: `Attachments, report.pdf, notes.txt`.

@astryx.kbd.key.alt.description: Spoken name of the Alt modifier key in a keyboard shortcut's accessible name.

@astryx.kbd.key.altShort.description: Abbreviated visible label of the Alt keycap on non-Apple platforms (Apple platforms show the Option symbol). Localize to the keyboard's conventional short label.

@astryx.kbd.key.backspace.description: Spoken name of the Backspace key in a keyboard shortcut's accessible name.

@astryx.kbd.key.command.description: Spoken name of the Command modifier key on Apple platforms in a keyboard shortcut's accessible name.

@astryx.kbd.key.control.description: Spoken name of the Control modifier key in a keyboard shortcut's accessible name. Also resolves the mod key on non-Apple platforms.

@astryx.kbd.key.controlShort.description: Abbreviated visible label of the Control keycap used for mod on non-Apple platforms. Localize to the keyboard's conventional short label.

@astryx.kbd.key.down.description: Spoken name of the down arrow key in a keyboard shortcut's accessible name.

@astryx.kbd.key.enter.description: Spoken name of the Enter or Return key in a keyboard shortcut's accessible name.

@astryx.kbd.key.escape.description: Spoken name of the Escape key in a keyboard shortcut's accessible name. Also used for the esc alias.

@astryx.kbd.key.escapeShort.description: Abbreviated visible label of the Escape keycap. Also used for the esc alias.

@astryx.kbd.key.left.description: Spoken name of the left arrow key in a keyboard shortcut's accessible name.

@astryx.kbd.key.plus.description: Spoken name of the literal plus key in a keyboard shortcut's accessible name, distinct from the separator between keys.

@astryx.kbd.key.right.description: Spoken name of the right arrow key in a keyboard shortcut's accessible name.

@astryx.kbd.key.shift.description: Spoken name of the Shift modifier key in a keyboard shortcut's accessible name.

@astryx.kbd.key.shiftShort.description: Abbreviated visible label of the Shift keycap on non-Apple platforms (Apple platforms show the Shift symbol). Localize to the keyboard's conventional short label.

@astryx.kbd.key.tab.description: Spoken name of the Tab key in a keyboard shortcut's accessible name.

@astryx.kbd.key.up.description: Spoken name of the up arrow key in a keyboard shortcut's accessible name.

@astryx.kbd.key.windowsShort.description: Abbreviated visible label of the Windows logo keycap, shown for the meta key on non-Apple platforms. Localize to the keyboard's conventional short label.

@astryx.kbd.shortcut.description: Combines spoken key names into one keyboard shortcut's accessible name. {shortcut} is the preceding keys and {key} is the next key's localized spoken name. Applied once for each key after the first; translators may change the separator or order.

@astryx.keyboardHint.toNavigate.description: Trailing text in the keyboard-hint badge, shown after arrow-key icons — reads as `← → to navigate`. Lowercase sentence fragment completing the visual phrase; the badge is aria-hidden, so this is for sighted users only.

@astryx.lightbox.mediaViewer.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for the Lightbox dialog when the current media item has no alt text. Should rarely render — consumers should provide alt.

@astryx.lightbox.zoom.description: Screen-reader-only label on the Lightbox image acting as a zoom toggle button (aria-pressed reflects zoomed state). Verb ("to zoom"), very short.

@astryx.lightbox.zoomedIn.defaultMessage: 已放大，使用箭头键平移
@astryx.lightbox.zoomedIn.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after zooming into a Lightbox image, including a hint that arrow keys pan while zoomed. Pairs with `lightbox.zoomedOut`.

@astryx.lightbox.zoomedOut.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after zooming back out of a Lightbox image. Pairs with `lightbox.zoomedIn`.

@astryx.lightbox.captionMore.description: Visible label of the button after a Lightbox caption that two lines cut short, for a single photo or a gallery. It opens the full caption over the photo. Pairs with `lightbox.captionLess`.

@astryx.lightbox.captionLess.description: Visible label of the same button while a Lightbox caption is open in full over the photo. It closes the full caption. Pairs with `lightbox.captionMore`.

@astryx.metadataList.showMore.description: Button label under a MetadataList that reveals items hidden beyond the configured maximum. Toggles with `metadataList.showLess` — keep the pair parallel in your language.

@astryx.metadataList.showLess.description: Button label under a MetadataList that re-hides the extra items revealed by `metadataList.showMore`. Keep the pair parallel.

@astryx.mobileNav.navigation.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for the MobileNav overlay dialog when no explicit label was passed.

@astryx.multiSelector.clearAll.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X that clears every selected value from a MultiSelector. Example: `Clear all Countries`. `{label}` is typically already plural in English.

@astryx.input.readOnly.description: Screen-reader-only description appended to a read-only form control when the platform does not expose aria-readonly for that control's host element. Short state label, not an instruction.

@astryx.input.statusButton.error.description: Accessible name for the focusable status icon button inside an input when statusVariant is 'tooltip' and the status type is error. Activating or focusing the button reveals the error message in a tooltip. Keep it short — it labels an icon-only button.

@astryx.input.statusButton.warning.description: Accessible name for the focusable status icon button inside an input when statusVariant is 'tooltip' and the status type is warning. Activating or focusing the button reveals the warning message in a tooltip.

@astryx.input.statusButton.success.description: Accessible name for the focusable status icon button inside an input when statusVariant is 'tooltip' and the status type is success. Activating or focusing the button reveals the success message in a tooltip.

@astryx.numberInput.clearLabel.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X that clears the value from a NumberInput. Example: `Clear Age`, `Clear Quantity`.

@astryx.numberInput.decrementLabel.description: Accessible label for the NumberInput button that decreases the value by one configured step. Example: `Decrement Quantity`.

@astryx.numberInput.incrementLabel.description: Accessible label for the NumberInput button that increases the value by one configured step. Example: `Increment Quantity`.

@astryx.numberInput.invalidNumber.description: Error in NumberInput, shown as the field's error status and announced, when Enter or blur meets typed text the field cannot commit: text that is not a number, a number with a fraction in a whole-number field, or any number while the field's minimum is above its maximum. The typed text stays in the field.

@astryx.selector.clearLabel.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X that clears the selected value from a Selector. `{label}` is the selector's visible label — example: `Clear Country`.

@astryx.sideNavCollapseButton.expandSide.description: Aria label AND tooltip on the SideNav collapse/expand toggle when the sidebar is currently collapsed (clicking expands it). Pairs with `collapseSidebar`.

@astryx.sideNavCollapseButton.collapseSi.description: Aria label AND tooltip on the same toggle when the sidebar is currently expanded (clicking collapses it). Pairs with `expandSidebar`.

@astryx.sideNavItem.expand.description: Screen-reader-only label on the chevron next to a SideNav item with children when the group is collapsed. Example: `Expand Settings`. Pairs with `sideNavItem.collapse`.

@astryx.sideNavItem.collapse.description: Screen-reader-only label on the same chevron when the group is expanded. Example: `Collapse Settings`. Pairs with `sideNavItem.expand`.

@astryx.sideNavItem.submenuLabel.description: Accessible name for the flyout dialog that opens from a collapsed (icon-only) SideNav item to show its sub-items. {label} is the parent item's label. Example: `Settings submenu`.

@astryx.tableFiltering.filterByColumn.description: Triple-use string on per-column filter controls: visible label, placeholder, AND aria label. `{header}` is the column header — example: `Filter Name`. Keep short.

@astryx.tableGroupedRows.expandGroup.description: Screen-reader-only label on the chevron next to a grouped table's group header when collapsed. Example: `Expand group Q1 2024`. Pairs with `collapseGroup`.

@astryx.tableGroupedRows.collapseGroup.description: Screen-reader-only label on the same chevron when the group is expanded. Example: `Collapse group Q1 2024`. Pairs with `expandGroup`.

@astryx.tableRowExpansion.collapseRow.description: Screen-reader-only label on the row-expand chevron when the row is currently expanded. Part of the four-way expand/collapse set.

@astryx.tableRowExpansion.collapseRowNam.description: Aria label for an expanded row expansion control when a human-readable identity is available. `label` is the row identity from getRowLabel.

@astryx.tableRowExpansion.expandRow.description: Screen-reader-only label on the row-expand chevron when the row is currently collapsed. Part of a four-way set with `collapseRow`, `expandAllRows`, `collapseAllRows`.

@astryx.tableRowExpansion.expandRowNamed.description: Aria label for a collapsed row expansion control when a human-readable identity is available. `label` is the row identity from getRowLabel.

@astryx.tableRowExpansion.columnHeader.description: Screen-reader-only header for the leading column that holds the per-row expand/collapse chevrons. The column shows no visible label.

@astryx.tableRowExpansion.collapseAllRow.description: Screen-reader-only label on the same header button when every row is expanded. Part of the four-way set.

@astryx.tableRowExpansion.expandAllRows.description: Screen-reader-only label on the header expand-all/collapse-all button when at least one row is collapsed (clicking expands every expandable row). Part of the four-way set.

@astryx.stepper.label.description: Screen-reader-only fallback name for the Stepper's ordered list of steps, describing the sequence as a whole (e.g. `Progress`). Used as the aria-label when the consumer does not pass a `label`. Singular per ARIA convention.

@astryx.stepper.previousStep.description: Accessible name and tooltip for the button that moves a Stepper back one step. Only rendered when the stepper is narrow enough that step labels have collapsed, and only when the stepper is navigable at all.

@astryx.stepper.nextStep.description: Accessible name and tooltip for the button that moves a Stepper forward one step. Counterpart to `stepper.previousStep`; keep the two parallel.

@astryx.step.goToStep.description: Accessible name for a clickable step in the Stepper. {stepNumber} is the 1-based position, {label} is the step's visible label.

@astryx.step.goToStepWithStatus.description: Accessible name for a clickable Stepper step that also carries a status. {status} is one of the translated `step.status.*` words (completed/warning/error). Keep the pattern parallel to `step.goToStep`.

@astryx.step.optional.description: Visible indicator appended after a Stepper step's label when the step is optional (isOptional). Very short; appears inline after the label text.

@astryx.step.status.completed.description: Screen-reader-only status word rendered next to a Stepper step label when the step is done (either progress-completed or status=success). Lowercase adjective; it is read mid-sentence after the step label.

@astryx.step.status.warning.description: Screen-reader-only status word rendered next to a Stepper step label when status=warning. Lowercase noun/adjective; read mid-sentence after the step label.

@astryx.step.status.error.description: Screen-reader-only status word rendered next to a Stepper step label when status=error. Lowercase noun; read mid-sentence after the step label.

@astryx.switch.loading.description: Screen-reader-only live-region announcement while a Switch is in its busy state (spinner shown, action in flight).

@astryx.tableTree.collapseRow.description: Aria label for the Table tree-data expander chevron when the row is currently expanded.

@astryx.tableTree.collapseRowNamed.description: Aria label for an expanded Table tree-data row when a human-readable identity is available. `label` is the row identity from getRowLabel.

@astryx.tableTree.expandRow.description: Aria label for the Table tree-data expander chevron when the row is currently collapsed.

@astryx.tableTree.expandRowNamed.description: Aria label for a collapsed Table tree-data row when a human-readable identity is available. `label` is the row identity from getRowLabel.

@astryx.tableTree.collapseAllRows.description: Aria label for the Table tree-data header toggle when all rows are expanded and clicking it collapses them.

@astryx.tableTree.expandAllRows.description: Aria label for the Table tree-data header toggle when rows are collapsed and clicking it expands them.

@astryx.textArea.counter.description: Visible character counter at the bottom of a TextArea that has a character limit, for example `62/2,000`. `{count}` is the characters typed so far and `{limit}` the limit; keep both numbers and reorder or change the separator if your language needs to.

@astryx.textArea.charactersRemaining.defaultMessage: 还剩 {count, number} {count, plural, other {个字符}}
@astryx.textArea.charactersRemaining.description: Screen-reader-only announcement of how many characters the user can still type before hitting a TextArea's maxLength. Announced politely as the count nears the limit. `{count}` is the number remaining — example: `12 characters remaining`.

@astryx.textArea.charactersOverLimit.defaultMessage: 超出 {count, number} {count, plural, other {个字符}}
@astryx.textArea.charactersOverLimit.description: Screen-reader-only assertive announcement when the user has typed past a TextArea's maxLength. `{count}` is how many characters over — example: `3 characters over the limit`.

@astryx.inputClearButton.tooltip.description: Tooltip shown on hover or keyboard focus over the X button inside an input that clears its value. Verb, imperative. Shown alone beside the field, so it names only the action; the screen-reader label names the field separately.

@astryx.textInput.clearLabel.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X that clears the value from a TextInput. Example: `Clear Email`, `Clear Name`.

@astryx.thumbnail.remove.description: Screen-reader-only label on the "×" on a Thumbnail (image preview chip). `{accessibleName}` is the thumbnail's name — example: `Remove profile.jpg`.

@astryx.thumbnail.open.description: "Open" = launch/reveal (not "unfold" or the adjective). Screen-reader-only name on a clickable Thumbnail — example: `Open Sunset photo`.

@astryx.thumbnail.fallbackName.description: Generic screen-reader name for a Thumbnail (image preview) that has no `alt` or `label`. Last-resort fallback so the control is never nameless; prefer a real name via `alt` or `label`.

@astryx.timeInput.clearLabel.description: Screen-reader-only label on the X that clears the value from a TimeInput. Example: `Clear Start time`.

@astryx.timestamp.copyValue.description: Aria label on a Timestamp copyable-hover-card row's copy button, in its default state. `value` is the formatted instant that row shows (e.g. `Copy February 19, 2026 at 5:00:00 PM UTC`). Imperative verb. Pairs with `timestamp.copied` (post-click state).

@astryx.timestamp.copy.description: Short label shown in the tooltip on a Timestamp copyable-hover-card row's copy button (hover/focus), in its default state. Imperative verb. Pairs with `timestamp.copied` (post-click state). The full `copyValue` string remains the button's aria-label for assistive tech.

@astryx.timestamp.copyFailed.description: Aria label, tooltip and screen-reader announcement on a Timestamp copy button for ~1.5s after the clipboard write fails. Pairs with `timestamp.copyValue` and `timestamp.copied`.

@astryx.timestamp.copied.description: Aria label on a Timestamp copy button for ~1.5s after a successful copy, and the text announced to a polite live region. Past-participle ("has been copied"); pairs with `timestamp.copyValue`.

@astryx.timestamp.detailsLabel.description: Accessible name for the Timestamp copyable hover card popup, which lists the instant in the configured time zones/formats with a copy button per row.

@astryx.token.remove.description: Screen-reader-only label on the "×" on an individual Token/chip. Example: `Remove John Smith`, `Remove Active`. Imperative verb.

@astryx.commandPalette.footer.navigate.description: Keyboard hint in the CommandPalette footer, paired with up/down arrow key icons. Tells users arrow keys move between items.

@astryx.commandPalette.footer.select.description: Keyboard hint in the CommandPalette footer, paired with the Enter key icon. Tells users Enter activates the highlighted item.

@astryx.commandPalette.footer.close.description: Keyboard hint in the CommandPalette footer, paired with the Escape key icon. Tells users Escape dismisses the palette.

@astryx.multiSelector.selectionCleared.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after the last selected option in a MultiSelector is deselected. Live-region text, never shown on screen; past participle ("has been cleared").

@astryx.multiSelector.allSelected.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after every option in a MultiSelector becomes selected. Live-region text, never shown on screen; "all" is a determiner (as in "all the options").

@astryx.multiSelector.selectionCount.defaultMessage: 已选择 {count, number} 项，共 {total, number} 项
@astryx.multiSelector.selectionCount.description: Polite screen-reader announcement of how many MultiSelector options are selected out of the total, spoken after each toggle. Live-region text, never shown on screen; example: `3 of 12 selected`.

@astryx.multiSelector.selectedCount.description: Visible text on a closed MultiSelector's trigger when it shows a count of the chosen options (`triggerDisplay="count"`), for example `2 selected`. `{count}` is the number of chosen options; use a plural form if your language needs one.

@astryx.multiSelector.createOption.description: Label of the first row in a MultiSelector's search panel when `hasCreate` is set and the typed text matches no option. Picking it reports a creation to the caller. `{query}` is the trimmed text the person typed, shown in quotes.

@astryx.multiSelector.optionCreated.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after the create row of a MultiSelector is picked. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{label}` is the text the person typed.

@astryx.multiSelector.emptySearchResults.description: Shown in a MultiSelector's dropdown panel when the search query matches no options, and announced in a polite live region at the same time. Short; neutral tone (not error-y).

@astryx.multiSelector.resultCount.defaultMessage: {count, number} {count, plural, one {个结果} other {个结果}}
@astryx.multiSelector.resultCount.description: Polite screen-reader announcement of how many MultiSelector options match the search query, spoken as the user types. Live-region text, never shown on screen; example: `1 result`, `12 results`.

@astryx.selector.emptySearchResults.description: Shown in a Selector's dropdown panel when the search query matches no options, and announced in a polite live region at the same time. Short; neutral tone (not error-y).

@astryx.selector.resultCount.defaultMessage: {count, number} {count, plural, one {个结果} other {个结果}}
@astryx.selector.resultCount.description: Polite screen-reader announcement of how many Selector options match the search query, spoken as the user types. Live-region text, never shown on screen; example: `1 result`, `12 results`.

@astryx.typeahead.resultCount.defaultMessage: {count, number} {count, plural, one {个结果} other {个结果}}
@astryx.typeahead.resultCount.description: Polite screen-reader announcement of how many suggestions a Typeahead search returned. Live-region text, never shown on screen; example: `1 result`, `12 results`.

@astryx.tokenizer.tokenAdded.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after a token is added to a Tokenizer, either picked from the suggestions or newly created. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{label}` is the token's visible text.

@astryx.tokenizer.tokenRemoved.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after a token is removed from a Tokenizer, by its × button or by Backspace. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{label}` is the token's visible text.

@astryx.tokenizer.search.description: Accessible name of the search field at the top of a Tokenizer's bottom sheet (the touch presentation). `{label}` is the field's own label, e.g. `Search Tags`. Not shown on screen.

@astryx.tokenizer.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside the search field at the top of a Tokenizer's bottom sheet, shown while the query is empty. Single word plus ellipsis.

@astryx.tokenizer.noResultsDescription.description: Supporting sentence under the no-results empty-state title inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet, suggesting the person change the query.

@astryx.tokenizer.create.description: Label of a Tokenizer's create row, in the inline menu and the bottom sheet, when `hasCreate` is set and the typed text matches no existing item. `{value}` is the typed text, e.g. `Create "Marketing"`.

@astryx.tokenizer.add.description: Visible label of the button at the end of the create row inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet; pressing it adds the typed text as a new token. Imperative verb; short.

@astryx.tokenizer.addValue.description: Screen-reader-only name of the create row's Add button inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet. `{value}` is the typed text, e.g. `Add Marketing`.

@astryx.tokenizer.done.description: Label for immediate-apply Tokenizer bottom-sheet flows. Draft selection flows use tokenizer.save.

@astryx.tokenizer.save.description: Label of the primary footer button inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet; pressing it commits the current selection draft and closes the sheet. Imperative verb; short.

@astryx.tokenizer.selectionLimit.defaultMessage: 最多选择 {count, plural, other {# 项}}
@astryx.tokenizer.selectionLimit.description: Tooltip on the disabled Save action when a Tokenizer selection draft exceeds a maxEntries limit that changed while the sheet was open. `{count}` is the current maximum.

@astryx.tokenizer.discardChangesTitle.description: Title of the confirmation dialog shown when someone tries to dismiss a Tokenizer bottom sheet after changing its selection draft. A question.

@astryx.tokenizer.discardChangesDescript.defaultMessage: 你对 {label} 的更改尚未保存。
@astryx.tokenizer.discardChangesDescript.description: Body of the dirty-dismiss confirmation inside a Tokenizer bottom sheet. `{label}` is the field label, e.g. `Your changes to Tags haven't been saved.`

@astryx.tokenizer.keepEditing.description: Label of the safe cancel action in the Tokenizer dirty-dismiss confirmation. It closes the confirmation and returns to the unchanged draft.

@astryx.tokenizer.discardChanges.description: Label of the destructive action in the Tokenizer dirty-dismiss confirmation. It closes the sheet without committing its selection draft.

@astryx.tokenizer.clearAllTitle.description: Title of the confirmation dialog shown when the person presses Clear all inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet. A question.

@astryx.tokenizer.clearAllDescription.defaultMessage: 这将从 {label} 中移除所有已选项目。
@astryx.tokenizer.clearAllDescription.description: Body of the Clear all confirmation dialog inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet. `{label}` is the field's own label, e.g. `This removes all selected items from Tags.`

@astryx.tokenizer.nothingToClear.description: Tooltip on the disabled Clear all action in a Tokenizer's bottom sheet while no item is selected; keeps the action focusable and says why it does nothing.

@astryx.tokenizer.allRemoved.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after a Tokenizer's Clear all has removed every selected item: the inline Clear all button, or a confirmed Clear all in the bottom sheet. Live-region text, never shown on screen.

@astryx.tokenizer.selectedCount.description: Screen-reader-only lead-in of the description on a Tokenizer's bottom-sheet trigger (the touch presentation), followed by the selected token labels. `{count}` is how many tokens are selected, e.g. `2 selected`. Not shown on screen.

@astryx.tokenizer.clearSelection.description: Label of the destructive action button in the Clear all confirmation dialog inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet. Imperative verb phrase; confirms removing every token.

@astryx.lightbox.imagePosition.defaultMessage: 第 {index, number} 张图片，共 {total, number} 张
@astryx.lightbox.imagePosition.description: Polite screen-reader announcement when a Lightbox moves to a media item that has no alt text. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{index}` is 1-based, example: `Image 3 of 12`.

@astryx.lightbox.mediaPosition.defaultMessage: {alt}，第 {index, number} 项，共 {total, number} 项
@astryx.lightbox.mediaPosition.description: Polite screen-reader announcement when a Lightbox moves to a media item that has alt text, composing that alt with the item's position. Live-region text, never shown on screen; example: `Sunset over the bay, 3 of 12`.

@astryx.transferList.selectedLabel.description: Default heading above the right-hand panel of a lab TransferList, which holds the options the user has chosen. Consumers usually override this with a domain noun (e.g. "Shown columns").

@astryx.transferList.availableLabel.description: Default heading above the left-hand panel of a lab TransferList, which holds the options not yet chosen. Consumers usually override this with a domain noun (e.g. "Hidden columns").

@astryx.transferList.ungroupedLabel.description: Heading for the bucket of available options that have no `group` set, shown only when some options are grouped and some are not so the ungrouped ones still have a heading.

@astryx.transferList.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the single search field that filters both panels of a lab TransferList. Same English as `selector.searchPlaceholder` but a separate key so it can be phrased for two lists.

@astryx.transferList.searchLabel.description: Screen-reader-only label on the search field of a lab TransferList, naming what is being searched. `{label}` is the component's own label (e.g. "Search Table columns").

@astryx.transferList.selectedEmpty.description: Message shown inside the selected panel of a lab TransferList when the user has chosen nothing yet.

@astryx.transferList.availableEmpty.description: Message shown inside the available panel of a lab TransferList when every option has already been moved to the selected panel.

@astryx.transferList.noResults.description: Message shown inside either panel of a lab TransferList when the search query matches nothing in that panel.

@astryx.transferList.clear.description: Label on the bulk action in a lab TransferList's selected-panel header that removes every option that is allowed to be removed. Locked options stay.

@astryx.transferList.addAll.description: Label on the bulk action in a lab TransferList's available-panel header that moves every remaining option into the selected panel.

@astryx.transferList.addOption.description: Accessible label on the per-row + button that moves one option into the selected panel of a lab TransferList. `{label}` is that option's visible text (e.g. "Add Owner").

@astryx.transferList.removeOption.description: Accessible label on the per-row × button that moves one option out of the selected panel of a lab TransferList. `{label}` is that option's visible text (e.g. "Remove Name").

@astryx.transferList.reorderOption.description: Accessible label on the per-row drag handle that reorders one option within the selected panel of a lab TransferList. `{label}` is that option's visible text (e.g. "Reorder Name").

@astryx.transferList.transferDisabled.description: Default tooltip explaining why a locked option in a lab TransferList cannot be transferred between panels. `{label}` is the option's visible text. Consumers may override per option.

@astryx.transferList.reorderDisabled.description: Default tooltip explaining why a locked option in a lab TransferList cannot be moved within the selected panel. `{label}` is the option's visible text. Consumers may override per option.

@astryx.transferList.reorderInstructions.defaultMessage: 按 Space 或 Enter 拾起项目。使用 Arrow Up、Arrow Down、Home 或 End 移动项目。按 Space 或 Enter 放下，或按 Escape 取消。
@astryx.transferList.reorderInstructions.description: Screen-reader-only instructions describing the keyboard reorder contract, referenced by every drag handle in a lab TransferList. Never shown on screen. Name the actual keys your locale's users press.

@astryx.transferList.announceAdded.defaultMessage: 已添加 {label}。已选择 {count, number} {count, plural, one {个项目} other {个项目}}。
@astryx.transferList.announceAdded.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after one option moves into the selected panel of a lab TransferList. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{label}` is the option's visible text and `{count}` is the new selected total.

@astryx.transferList.announceRemoved.defaultMessage: 已移除 {label}。已选择 {count, number} {count, plural, one {个项目} other {个项目}}。
@astryx.transferList.announceRemoved.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after one option moves out of the selected panel of a lab TransferList. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{label}` is the option's visible text and `{count}` is the new selected total.

@astryx.transferList.announceBulkAdded.defaultMessage: 已添加 {count, number} {count, plural, one {个项目} other {个项目}}。
@astryx.transferList.announceBulkAdded.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after the Add all bulk action in a lab TransferList. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{count}` is how many options moved.

@astryx.transferList.announceBulkRemoved.defaultMessage: 已移除 {count, number} {count, plural, one {个项目} other {个项目}}。
@astryx.transferList.announceBulkRemoved.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after the Clear bulk action in a lab TransferList. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{count}` is how many options moved.

@astryx.transferList.announceGrabbed.defaultMessage: 已拾起 {label}，位于第 {position, number} 个位置，共 {total, number} 个位置。使用箭头键移动，按 Space 或 Enter 放下，或按 Escape 取消。
@astryx.transferList.announceGrabbed.description: Polite screen-reader announcement when a lab TransferList row enters keyboard reorder mode. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{position}` is 1-based within the selected panel.

@astryx.transferList.announceMoveCancell.description: Polite screen-reader announcement when a lab TransferList reorder is abandoned with Escape or a cancelled pointer drag, restoring the original order. Live-region text, never shown on screen.

@astryx.transferList.announceDropped.defaultMessage: 已将 {label} 放在第 {position, number} 个位置，共 {total, number} 个位置。
@astryx.transferList.announceDropped.description: Polite screen-reader announcement when a lab TransferList reorder commits at a new position. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{position}` is 1-based within the selected panel.

@astryx.transferList.announceReturned.defaultMessage: {label} 已返回第 {position, number} 个位置。
@astryx.transferList.announceReturned.description: Polite screen-reader announcement when a lab TransferList pointer drag ends where it began, so the order did not change. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{position}` is 1-based.

@astryx.transferList.announceMovedToPosi.defaultMessage: {label}，第 {position, number} 个位置，共 {total, number} 个位置。
@astryx.transferList.announceMovedToPosi.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after each arrow-key step of an in-progress lab TransferList reorder. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{position}` is 1-based within the selected panel.

@astryx.transferList.announceSearchResul.defaultMessage: 找到 {count, number} {count, plural, one {个项目} other {个项目}}。
@astryx.transferList.announceSearchResul.description: Polite screen-reader announcement of how many options a lab TransferList search matched across both panels. Live-region text, never shown on screen.

@astryx.transferListSelector.apply.description: Label on the button that commits the staged draft of a lab TransferListSelector and closes it. Only rendered in staged commit mode.

@astryx.transferListSelector.cancel.description: Label on the button that discards the staged draft of a lab TransferListSelector and closes it. Only rendered in staged commit mode.

@astryx.transferListSelector.triggerLabe.description: Default summary on the closed trigger of a lab TransferListSelector, stating how many options are currently chosen. Consumers usually override this with a domain phrase (e.g. "7 columns").

@astryx.emojiPicker.label.description: Default accessible name of the scrolling list of emoji in a lab EmojiPicker, and the footer text when no emoji is hovered or focused.

@astryx.emojiPicker.searchLabel.description: Default placeholder and hidden label of the search field of a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.frequentlyUsed.description: Heading of the first group in a lab EmojiPicker, the host's frequent or recent emoji.

@astryx.emojiPicker.searchResults.description: Heading of the single group a lab EmojiPicker shows while its search field has text.

@astryx.emojiPicker.noResults.defaultMessage: 没有与“{query}”匹配的表情符号
@astryx.emojiPicker.noResults.description: Shown in a lab EmojiPicker when no emoji name or keyword matches the search. `query` is the search text.

@astryx.emojiPicker.loading.description: Accessible name of the spinner a lab EmojiPicker shows while its bundled emoji set loads.

@astryx.emojiPicker.loadFailed.defaultMessage: 更多表情符号无法加载。
@astryx.emojiPicker.loadFailed.description: Shown in a lab EmojiPicker when its bundled emoji set failed to load; the frequent emoji still show.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupSmileysEmotion.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of faces and emotions in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupPeopleBody.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of people, gestures, and body parts in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupAnimalsNature.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of animals and plants in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupFoodDrink.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of food and drink in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupTravelPlaces.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of places, vehicles, and weather in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupActivities.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of sports, games, and events in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupObjects.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of everyday objects in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupSymbols.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of signs and symbols in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupFlags.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of flags in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.comments.retry.description: Action on an error Banner in a lab Comments panel or comment composer that repeats the action that failed.

@astryx.commentComposer.placeholder.description: Default placeholder of a lab CommentComposer, the input for a new comment in a discussion.

@astryx.commentComposer.noAgents.description: Shown in a lab CommentComposer's slash-command menu when no AI agent matches what was typed after `/`.

@astryx.commentComposer.agents.description: Accessible name of a lab CommentComposer's slash-command menu, which lists the AI agents a comment can address.

@astryx.commentComposer.uploadFailed.description: Error Banner title in a lab CommentComposer when uploading attached images failed; a Retry action follows.

@astryx.commentComposer.imagesOnly.description: Error Banner title in a lab CommentComposer when a non-image file was attached, pasted, or dropped.

@astryx.commentComposer.chooseImages.description: Action on a lab CommentComposer's error Banner that opens the file chooser for images.

@astryx.commentComposer.imageAlt.description: Alt text a lab CommentComposer writes into the comment for an uploaded image that came with none.

@astryx.commentComposer.removeQuote.description: Button beside the quoted passage in a lab CommentComposer that drops the quote from the new inline comment.

@astryx.commentComposer.attachImages.description: Button in a lab CommentComposer that opens the file chooser to add images to the comment.

@astryx.commentComposer.addEmoji.description: Button in a lab CommentComposer that opens the emoji picker, and the accessible name of that picker's popover.

@astryx.commentComposer.cancel.description: Text button beside the label of a lab CommentComposer that is editing an existing comment; it discards the edit.

@astryx.comments.actionsLabel.description: Accessible name of a comment's actions menu button in a lab Comments panel. `name` is the comment author's name.

@astryx.comments.addReaction.description: Button on a comment in a lab Comments panel that opens the set of reactions to choose from.

@astryx.comments.agentBadge.description: Badge beside the name of a comment author in a lab Comments panel that is an AI agent rather than a person.

@astryx.comments.agentLogo.description: Alt text of an AI agent's logo used as its avatar in a lab Comments panel. `name` is the agent's name.

@astryx.comments.chooseReaction.description: Accessible name of the popover listing the reactions a comment can take in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.copyLink.description: Button on a comment in a lab Comments panel that copies a link to the comment.

@astryx.comments.currentVersion.description: Marks the version shown now in the edit history dialog of a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.delete.description: Item in a comment's actions menu, and the confirming action of the delete dialog, in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.deleteDescription.defaultMessage: 删除 {name} 的评论？此操作无法撤销。
@astryx.comments.deleteDescription.description: Body of the dialog that confirms deleting a comment in a lab Comments panel. `name` is the comment's author.

@astryx.comments.deleteFailed.description: Error shown on a comment in a lab Comments panel when deleting it failed.

@astryx.comments.deleteFailedRetry.defaultMessage: 此评论无法删除。请重试。
@astryx.comments.deleteFailedRetry.description: Text the delete confirmation dialog of a lab Comments panel shows, and announces, after deleting failed.

@astryx.comments.deleteTitle.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting a comment in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.edit.description: Item in a comment's actions menu in a lab Comments panel that edits the viewer's own comment.

@astryx.comments.editFailed.description: Error shown on a comment in a lab Comments panel when saving an edit failed; a Retry action follows.

@astryx.comments.editPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the composer that edits an existing comment in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.edited.description: Text beside a comment's time in a lab Comments panel marking that it was changed after posting; it opens the edit history when one exists.

@astryx.comments.editingContext.description: Label above the composer that edits an existing comment in a lab Comments panel; a Cancel action follows it.

@astryx.comments.hideReplies.description: Text button under an open comment thread in a lab Comments panel that collapses its replies.

@astryx.comments.historyEmptyDescription.defaultMessage: 此评论没有更早的版本。
@astryx.comments.historyEmptyDescription.description: Empty-state description of the edit history dialog of a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.historyEmptyTitle.description: Empty-state title of the edit history dialog of a lab Comments panel for a comment with no earlier versions.

@astryx.comments.historyFailed.description: Error Banner title in the edit history dialog of a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.historyLoadFailed.defaultMessage: 无法加载此评论的编辑历史。请重试。
@astryx.comments.historyLoadFailed.description: Error description in the edit history dialog of a lab Comments panel when loading the versions failed.

@astryx.comments.historyLoading.description: Accessible name of the spinner shown while a comment's earlier versions load in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.historySubtitle.description: Subtitle of the edit history dialog in a lab Comments panel. `name` is the comment's author.

@astryx.comments.historyTitle.description: Title of the dialog listing a comment's earlier versions in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.linkCopyFailed.description: Label, tooltip and screen-reader announcement the Copy comment link button takes for two seconds after the clipboard write fails, in a lab Comments panel. Pairs with `comments.copyLink` and `comments.linkCopied`.

@astryx.comments.linkCopied.description: Label the Copy comment link button takes for two seconds after copying, in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.otherReactors.description: Last item of the list of people who reacted to a comment in a lab Comments panel, for those not named. `count` is how many.

@astryx.comments.outdated.description: Badge beside the quoted passage of an inline comment in a lab Comments panel when that passage was edited away.

@astryx.comments.reactionCelebrate.description: Name of the party-popper reaction offered by default on comments in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.reactionCount.description: Accessible name of a reaction toggle on a comment in a lab Comments panel. `reaction` is the reaction's name, e.g. "Like"; `count` is how many people reacted.

@astryx.comments.reactionFailed.defaultMessage: 你的表情回应无法保存。
@astryx.comments.reactionFailed.description: Error shown on a comment in a lab Comments panel when adding or removing a reaction failed.

@astryx.comments.reactionLaugh.description: Name of the laughing reaction offered by default on comments in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.reactionLike.description: Name of the thumbs-up reaction offered by default on comments in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.reactionLove.description: Name of the red-heart reaction offered by default on comments in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.reactionSad.description: Name of the crying reaction offered by default on comments in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.reactionWow.description: Name of the surprised reaction offered by default on comments in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.reopen.description: Button on a resolved comment thread in a lab Comments panel that reopens it.

@astryx.comments.reopenFailed.defaultMessage: 此讨论串无法重新打开。
@astryx.comments.reopenFailed.description: Error shown on a comment thread in a lab Comments panel when reopening it failed.

@astryx.comments.reply.description: Button on a comment in a lab Comments panel that opens a reply to it.

@astryx.comments.replyFailed.description: Error shown above a reply composer in a lab Comments panel when posting failed; the draft is kept.

@astryx.comments.replyPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the reply composer in a lab Comments panel comment thread. `name` is the author of the comment being answered.

@astryx.comments.replyingContext.description: Accessible context for the reply composer in a lab Comments panel comment thread. `name` is the author of the comment being answered.

@astryx.comments.resolve.description: Button on a comment thread in a lab Comments panel that marks the thread resolved.

@astryx.comments.resolveFailed.defaultMessage: 此讨论串无法标记为已解决。
@astryx.comments.resolveFailed.description: Error shown on a comment thread in a lab Comments panel when marking it resolved failed.

@astryx.comments.resolved.description: Text beside a comment thread's time in a lab Comments panel marking the thread resolved.

@astryx.comments.resolvedBy.description: Tooltip of the Resolved text on a comment thread in a lab Comments panel. `name` is the person who resolved it.

@astryx.comments.errorAnnouncement.description: Screen-reader announcement for an error Banner in a lab Comments panel that has a title and a description, read once when the Banner appears. `title` is the Banner's title (for example `Couldn't send this comment.`) and `description` its description (for example `Retrying didn't work.`). Reorder or punctuate as the language needs.

@astryx.comments.retryFailed.description: Error shown on a comment in a lab Comments panel that failed to post when retrying it failed too.

@astryx.comments.sendFailed.description: Error Banner title on a comment in a lab Comments panel that failed to post, when the host gave no message of its own.

@astryx.comments.threadLabel.description: Accessible name of the toggle that opens or closes a comment thread in a lab Comments panel. `name` is the author of the thread's first comment.

@astryx.comments.unread.description: Badge on a comment in a lab Comments panel the viewer hasn't read yet.

@astryx.comments.unsavedDraft.defaultMessage: 草稿未保存。再次关闭将放弃草稿。
@astryx.comments.unsavedDraft.description: Announced to screen readers when a lab CommentThread refuses its first dismissal because a reply or edit holds unsaved text; a second press outside the thread or a second Escape discards the draft.

@astryx.comments.versionAuthor.description: Byline beside the time of one version in the edit history dialog of a lab Comments panel. `name` is who saved that version.

@astryx.comments.viewHistory.description: Accessible name of the Edited text button on a comment in a lab Comments panel, which opens the comment's earlier versions.

@astryx.comments.viewReplies.defaultMessage: 查看 {count, plural, other {# 条回复}}
@astryx.comments.viewReplies.description: Text button under a collapsed comment thread in a lab Comments panel that opens it. `count` is the number of replies.

@astryx.comments.commentsLabel.description: Accessible name of the scrolling list of comment threads in a lab Comments panel. `label` is the panel's own accessible name, e.g. "Comments" or "Launch plan".

@astryx.comments.emptyDescription.description: Description under the empty-state title of a lab Comments panel when the viewer can comment.

@astryx.comments.emptyReadOnlyDescriptio.description: Description under the empty-state title of a lab Comments panel the viewer can only read.

@astryx.comments.emptyTitle.description: Title of the empty state of a lab Comments panel with no comments or activity.

@astryx.comments.label.description: Default accessible name of the lab Comments region, which holds the comment threads about one item. Hosts usually override it with the item's own noun.

@astryx.comments.loadFailed.description: Error Banner title in a lab Comments panel when its comments failed to load.

@astryx.comments.loadOlder.description: Button above the threads of a lab Comments panel that loads the previous page of comments.

@astryx.comments.loading.description: Visually hidden text read by screen readers while a lab Comments panel shows comment-shaped loading placeholders.

@astryx.comments.olderFailed.description: Error Banner title in a lab Comments panel when the page of earlier comments failed to load; a Retry action follows.

@astryx.comments.postFailed.description: Error shown above the new-comment composer of a lab Comments panel when posting failed; the draft is kept and a Retry action follows.

@astryx.infoTip.label.description: Default accessible name of an InfoTip, the small info-icon button whose press reveals help about the label, value, or metric beside it.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.play.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that starts playback in a lab media player (video or audio).

@astryx.mediaPlayer.pause.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that pauses playback in a lab media player.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.replay.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the play button in a lab media player after the media has ended; pressing it plays from the start.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.skipBack.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that moves playback back in a lab media player. `seconds` is how far it moves, e.g. 15.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.skipForward.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that moves playback forward in a lab media player. `seconds` is how far it moves, e.g. 30.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.mute.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that silences a lab media player.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.unmute.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that turns sound back on in a lab media player.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.volume.description: Accessible name of the volume slider in a lab media player.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.seek.description: Accessible name of the timeline slider in a lab media player; moving it changes the playback position.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.timeValue.description: Spoken value of the timeline slider in a lab media player. `current` is the playback position and `duration` the total length, both already written as words, e.g. "1 minute, 5 seconds".

@astryx.mediaPlayer.timeValueContext.description: Spoken value of the timeline slider in a lab media player when the position is inside a chapter or at a marker. `value` is the spoken time, e.g. "1 minute, 5 seconds of 3 minutes", and `context` is the chapter title or the marker label, e.g. "Pollen".

@astryx.mediaPlayer.previousTrack.description: Name and tooltip of the button in a lab audio player that goes to the previous track or episode in the product's queue.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.nextTrack.description: Name and tooltip of the button in a lab audio player that goes to the next track or episode in the product's queue.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.live.description: Shown instead of the playback time in a lab media player when the media is a live stream.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.captions.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the toggle button that turns captions on and off in a lab video player.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.enterFullscreen.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that shows a lab video player over the whole screen.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.exitFullscreen.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that leaves full screen in a lab video player.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.playbackSpeed.description: Tooltip of the button that opens the playback speed menu of a lab media player, and the name of the list of speeds in that menu.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.playbackSpeedValue.description: Accessible name of the button that opens the playback speed menu of a lab media player. {rate} is the current speed as a number, such as 1.5; × means times normal speed.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.playbackRate.description: Visible label of the playback speed menu button in a lab media player, and of each speed in its menu. `rate` is the speed, already formatted as a number, e.g. "1.5"; × means times normal speed.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.error.description: Message a lab media player shows when the browser cannot play its video or audio; a Try again button follows.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.retry.description: Label of the button that loads the media again after a lab media player failed to play it.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.announceMuted.description: Screen reader announcement after a keyboard shortcut silences a lab media player.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.announceUnmuted.description: Screen reader announcement after a keyboard shortcut turns sound back on in a lab media player.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.announceCaptionsOn.description: Screen reader announcement after a keyboard shortcut turns captions on in a lab video player.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.announceCaptionsOff.description: Screen reader announcement after a keyboard shortcut turns captions off in a lab video player.

@astryx.mediaPlayer.announceVolume.description: Screen reader announcement after a keyboard shortcut changes the volume of a lab media player. `percent` is already formatted, e.g. "40%".

@astryx.mediaPlayer.announceSpeed.description: Screen reader announcement after a keyboard shortcut changes how fast a lab media player plays. `rate` is already formatted, e.g. "1.5"; × means times normal speed.

@astryx.navigationStack.back.description: Label of the back button in a lab NavigationStack's bar when the screen it returns to has no title of its own. Returns to the previous screen; keep it short, as on an iOS navigation bar.

@astryx.searchField.cancel.description: Accessible name of a lab SearchField's close button, which ends the search: it clears the query, ends editing and deactivates the field.
